title: E-commerce Ad Creative Editor (Video + Static) – AI Tools | Part-Time
description:
(Please do not apply via message, read carefully the job description below)



We are looking for an E-commerce Ad Creative Editor to join our team on a long-term, part-time basis.



This is NOT a general video editing position.



You will mainly create and adapt performance ad creatives for e-commerce / dropshipping brands, especially for Meta Ads.



Your role will be highly execution-focused.



You will receive clear briefs, scripts, reference ads, competitor creatives and internal processes to follow.



Your job is to execute them quickly, accurately and consistently.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your tasks will include:



• Editing e-commerce video ads for Meta/Facebook

• Recreating existing winning ads for different brands or markets

• Translating and localizing existing ad creatives

• Creating new ads from scripts and creative briefs

• Creating static image ads

• Adding subtitles, hooks, graphics, B-roll, UGC clips and product footage

• Creating AI-generated scenes, avatars, voiceovers or visuals

• Working with AI tools to speed up creative production

• Adapting creatives into different languages and markets

• Following reference ads very closely when required

• Exporting creatives in the correct formats for advertising

• Performing a final quality check before delivery



TOOLS



You should already be comfortable with several of the following:



• CapCut

• HeyGen

• Vmake

• ElevenLabs

• Nano Banana Pro

• ChatGPT

• Claude

• Canva 

• Premiere Pro or similar editing software



You do NOT need to personally pay for the tools required for the position.

We will provide access to the paid tools and accounts needed for your work.





WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who:



• Has previous experience editing e-commerce or dropshipping ads

• Understands short-form direct-response advertising

• Can create both VIDEO and STATIC ad creatives

• Is very comfortable using AI

• Can follow detailed instructions and SOPs accurately

• Can recreate reference creatives closely

• Has strong attention to detail

• Works quickly without sacrificing quality

• Has very good written and spoken English

• Has a reliable computer and internet connection

• Communicates reliably

• Is interested in working with us long-term



This is primarily an execution role.



You will not be expected to invent the entire marketing strategy yourself. In most cases, we will provide the script, reference creative, brief or process and you will execute it.





WORKING ARRANGEMENT



• Part-time

• Approximately 20 hours/week

• Usually around 2–4 hours/day depending on workload

• Remote

• Long-term position

• Up to $350 USD/month depending on experience

• Required software/tools will be provided by us

• Possibility for increased responsibilities and compensation over time





HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT:



Do not send us a generic OnlineJobs message.



To be considered, complete our application form here:







The application includes:



• Your editing and e-commerce experience

• 3 examples of ad creatives you personally worked on

• At least one AI-based creative

• Your computer and internet setup

• Your availability

• A short Loom video in ENGLISH explaining your previous work and creative process



Applications without the application form, creative examples and Loom video will not be reviewed.



If your profile is a good fit, we will contact you directly for the next step.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short PAID test task.



We are looking to hire quickly and build a long-term working relationship.

title: Amazon VA: Graphic Designer (Female)
description:
Position: We are looking for an experienced FEMALE Amazon Virtual Assistant specializing in Graphic design.

Our Business Model: Private Label (Note: we are not Wholesale, Online Arbitrage)

Full-time. 40 hours each week. Please do not apply if you are holding other jobs.

Remote (Work-from-home) 



We need an Amazon-focused graphic designer who understands Amazon’s specific image requirements, content formats, customer buying behavior, and Seller Central processes. The ideal candidate can create high-quality Amazon content, conduct competitor research, identify opportunities to improve clicks and conversions, and manage completed assets inside Amazon Seller Central. 



This is not a general graphic design role. We are looking for someone with proven Amazon experience, not someone who only knows how to use Photoshop, Illustrator, or AI tools. The right candidate understands how to create Amazon-specific visual content that is attractive, informative, and strategically optimized to support listing performance. 



RESPONSIBILITIES:

-Design and optimize Amazon listing images.

-Create Premium A+ Content for desktop and mobile.

-Design Amazon Brand Story modules and Storefront pages.

-Create product and packaging mockups.

-Design product packaging and box artwork using supplier-provided dielines. 

-Conduct market and competitor research using Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar tools to identify opportunities to improve our listing images, product messaging, layout, and overall presentation. 

-Use AI tools to generate specific image elements, backgrounds, settings, or concepts when needed. 

-Edit and refine all elements in Adobe Photoshop so the final images look realistic, accurate, and professional. 

-Upload and manage listing images, A+ Content, Brand Story, and Storefront content in Amazon Seller Central; monitor approval status, display quality, and mobile responsiveness; and revise designs based on feedback, performance results, and Amazon requirements. 

-Maintain organized source files, final files, revisions, and approved versions. 



REQUIREMENTS:

-FEMALE applicants only

-Must have proven work experience as an Amazon Graphic Designer or Amazon VA handling creative content for Amazon FBA Private Label products. Please do not apply without relevant Amazon experience.

-Must provide a strong portfolio showing Amazon listing images, Premium A+ Content, Brand Story, Storefront design, packaging design, and product mockups.

Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and strong working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator.

-Must understand Amazon image requirements, content formats, mobile layouts, and Seller Central processes.

-Experience with Amazon A/B testing or Manage Your Experiments is preferred.

-Familiarity with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar Amazon research tools.

-Experience using AI image-generation tools as part of a professional design workflow while maintaining realistic and accurate final results.

-Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, layout, branding, product accuracy, and conversion-focused design.

-Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret competitor findings and performance data.

-Strong communication skills, with proficiency in written and spoken English.

-Detail-oriented and highly organized, with a high level of accuracy.

-Strong time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, revisions, and deadlines.

-Proactive, resourceful, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.

-Willing to learn, adapt, and take on additional responsibilities over time.

-Must have a reliable, fully functional computer suitable for professional graphic design work.

-Must have a stable internet connection with a minimum speed of 20 Mbps.

-Must be comfortable using a time-tracking tool during working hours.



WHAT WE PROVIDE:

1. Asia working hours

2. Work-from-home setup

3. Bonus: 13th Month

4. Bonus: Year end

5. Long-term opportunity with career growth

6. Supportive and collaborative team 



HOW TO APPLY:

If you are interested in this position and believe you have the qualities listed above to be successful, please submit your applications with the following in the correct order:

1. Cover Letter

2. CV with your education and work experience in chronological order. (Pls. send us the public view link)

3. Portfolio: relevant work samples like Amazon images and A+ Content. (Pls. send us the public view link)

Note: Incomplete applications will not receive a response.



Join our team and grow with us!

Type: Part-time, independent contractor

Location: Remote 

Hours: Flexible, part-time — some overlap with AU business hours (NSW time) required. 

Rate: $8 AUD/hour



About the Role

We're a fast-growing Australian telehealth healthcare group looking for a detail-oriented, reliable Admin Assistant to support our operations on a part-time contractor basis. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on structured, repeatable processes and takes pride in accuracy and consistency.



Key Responsibilities

- Manage regular document workflows, including downloading, organising, uploading, and filing records across multiple online systems and portals

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in shared drives and internal trackers

- Support day-to-day administrative tasks across a small, fast-paced team

- Follow set processes closely and flag any discrepancies or issues promptly

- Handle sensitive information with strict confidentiality

- Assist with basic data entry and spreadsheet updates (Excel/Google Sheets)

- Occasional
, Slack and WhatsApp correspondence 



What We're Looking For

- Prior admin support experience, ideally with an Australian or international client

- Excellent attention to detail — this role involves repetitive, precision-based tasks where accuracy matters

- Comfortable navigating multiple online platforms/portals and following step-by-step procedures

- Strong English communication

- Reliable internet connection and own equipment

- Discreet and trustworthy with confidential data

- Experience with Google Workspace and Excel



Nice to Have

- Experience in healthcare, compliance, or regulated industries

- Experience with CRM or practice management systems



To Apply

Please send your CV, and a note on your availability. Introduction videos are welcome.

title: EXPERIENCED CREDIT REPAIR SPECIALIST / TEAM
description:
I’m looking for an experienced Credit Repair Specialist or established credit repair team capable of handling high client volume — up to 500 active clients.



This is NOT a position for someone who relies solely on sweeps or sends the same generic dispute every round.

REQUIRED:



Strong working knowledge of the FCRA and compliant dispute practices

An actual step-by-step dispute flow/strategy

Experience handling multiple dispute rounds and escalations

Ability to analyze credit reports and determine the appropriate strategy based on the individual file

Experience with collections, charge-offs, late payments, repossessions, inquiries, personal information, etc.

Must understand when/how to escalate disputes appropriately

Must have a team and systems already in place to support approximately 500 clients

Strong organization, documentation, and turnaround times



IMPORTANT:

During the interview process, you will be required to walk me through your process from Round 1 through escalation.

I want to see:

What you dispute ? How you dispute ? What happens when an item comes back verified/updated ? Your next step ? Your escalation process.

I am looking for someone with a REAL PROCESS, not someone whose entire strategy is based on sweeps.



Serious, experienced applicants only.

To apply, please send:

1. Years of experience

2. Current team size

3. Approximate number of clients your team can handle monthly

4. Credit repair software/systems you use

5. Brief overview of your dispute workflow

6. Your pricing/compensation requirements

If you cannot demonstrate your process, please do not apply.

title: B2B Appointment Setter (US East Coast hours) for IT Services Company, part-time, base plus bonus
description:
MatanoIT is a US-based IT services company (New Jersey) that helps small businesses with managed IT, Microsoft 365, phone systems, security, and websites. We are hiring one part-time appointment setter to call small businesses in the US and book short introductory calls for our founder.



This is not a generic script. Every business you call has already been reviewed by our system, and you will have specific, true findings about their
 domain or phone number to talk about. Your job is to explain the finding simply, find out who handles their technology, and book a 15-minute review call. You will not sell or quote prices.



What we require (please do not apply if you do not meet all of these):



At least 1 year of B2B cold calling to US businesses (appointment setting, lead gen, or outbound SDR).

Clear, confident, neutral English. You will be speaking with business owners and office managers.

Available 4 hours per day between 9:00 AM and 4:00 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday (20 hours per week to start).

Quiet workspace, reliable internet (10 Mbps or better), USB headset, and a laptop that can run a softphone.

Comfortable logging every call in a CRM and following a qualification checklist.



Pay:



$6 to $7 per hour depending on experience, paid weekly.

$15 bonus for every booked appointment where the prospect actually attends the call.

Two-week paid trial, then ongoing part-time with the option to add hours.



To apply, include all three or your application will be skipped:



A 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo link is fine) introducing yourself and describing your most recent US calling role.

The dialer or phone system you used most recently, and your average daily dial count.

Your available hours in US Eastern time.



Write "3CX" as the first word of your application so we know you read the whole post.

title: US Quickbooks Bookkeeper
description:
THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:

-Has experience working in an online consulting company or social media business in the online entrepreneurial space.

-Has an understanding of, or willingness to learn TikTok Shop affiliate or creator-based income streams and how they impact basic bookkeeping and revenue tracking.

-Is a quick start who quickly turns tasks around and takes action; knows how to be persistent and resourceful to solve -problems, remove roadblocks and get things done.

-Has strong EQ and can intuit next steps without needing a ton of direction- we like to call this “thinking ahead of the CEO.”

-Doesn’t take corrections personally and can handle a fast moving, sometimes high pressure business in social media.

-Is the type of person who makes a mistake once and instead of wasting energy beating yourself up and feeling bad channels that energy into implementing systems so that the same mistake is never repeated.

-Has a love for creating SOPs and regularly maintains and updates them for their job responsibilities without needing to be reminded to do so.

-Exhibits strong professionalism - demonstrated poise, tact, and diplomacy when dealing with the CEO, other leaders and members of the team. Can take feedback without taking it personally

-Must be able to work independently and excel in a deadline-driven environment that involves multiple, simultaneous projects and sometimes quick turnarounds.

-Strong skills in analyzing information, formulating logical and objective conclusions and making effective recommendations.

-Superior organization skills and dedication to completing projects in a timely manner.

-Has a genuine passion for supporting others and is a team player.

-Enjoys sharing ideas to improve processes within the company when they see gaps that can be improved.

-Has a high attention to detail- grammatical errors and typos never get past you.

-Enjoys taking ownership of their role and treats the company’s front-facing assets and appearance with the same level of excellence as if it was their own.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

-Assists Senior Admin team with onboarding new clients/brands through setting up payment pages for custom programs, managing the cancellation and off-boarding process, troubleshooting technical issues with the senior admin team, creating contracts in DocuSign and sending them out.

-From time to time support other admins in maintenance of the CEO's calendar or inboxes in a thoughtful and purposeful manner, guarding the CEO’s time by ensuring meetings contain the appropriate attendees, agenda items, links to Zoom, address details and any changes are done with full consideration of a nationwide/worldwide team, spanning multiple time zones.

-Drafting internal and external communications as needed and instructed by the senior admin team.

-Provide support with financial tasks and reporting

-Issue invoices to brands and clients upon completion of agreed deliverables, making sure all invoice requirements follow what is in the contract.

-Maintain accurate records of all invoices, payments received, outstanding balances, and client payment histories.

-Performs credit control activities like proactively following up on overdue invoices and maintaining regular communication with brands regarding outstanding payments.

-Monitor accounts receivable and provide regular reports on unpaid invoices

-Monitor credit and government loan accounts for the business to ensure no delinquency or late fees

-Prepare quarterly budgets and assist with financial planning for the CEO

-Track monthly revenue, lost revenue, and payment trends

-Reconcile bank accounts and PayPal

-Record and categorize all business income and expenses in the accounting system.

-Process reimbursements and maintain supporting documentation for all business expenses.



Experience and Skills Required:

-3+ years of bookkeeping experience

-Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks; QB certification a huge plus

-4-year degree in Accounting or a similar field

-Demonstrate a solid typing WPM (ideally 45 wpm)

-Excellent English skills, and able to communicate well both verbally and in writing

-Experience with remote team tools like Slack, Asana, Google Suite, LastPass, CocoSign (document signing), VideoAsk, Loom and Zoom



Tech Requirements:

-Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

-Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed





We are an asynchronous team, which means we work across various time zones. CEO is in the United States and typically works Monday-Friday, 10am-2pm Eastern Time



This is for a part-time position of about 20 hours per week with room to grow!



Salary Range: (20 hours) Php 24,000 to Php 42,000





Apply here: 
/appqNAvkEQ10YFlc3/pag1aWSMwCfLhrMXv/form

title: Director of Recruiting — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
US-based direct-hire staffing firm (healthcare/allied-health core, expanding into new verticals) is hiring a Director of Recruiting to own our ENTIRE delivery organization. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder — every recruiting lane, every recruiter, and the company-wide fill number are yours.



This is a staffing-agency delivery leadership seat, not a corporate HR/TA role. You inherit a live board of open US jobs and a small existing delivery team (including a recruiting manager), and you are accountable for one thing: jobs filled. You set the per-req fill strategy across the whole board, install the standards and cadence, coach and grow the team — and because we're a lean firm, you still personally recruit on the hardest, highest-value searches.



Responsibilities

- Own the company-wide open-req board: triage every US job, set a written fill strategy per req, kill or escalate stalled searches honestly.

- Lead the whole delivery org — the recruiting manager and delivery recruiters report to you; run the daily cadence, set quality-gated submittal standards per recruiter, and manage performance to them.

- Personally recruit full-cycle on priority searches: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit.

- Build the machine: playbooks, screening gates, KPIs, capacity plan; recruit and onboard recruiters as volume grows.

- Report the truth to the founder weekly with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



Required

- 6+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, with 3+ years leading delivery teams measured on submittals and placements — agency/staffing-firm side (BPO/RPO delivery centers serving US staffing firms count; in-house corporate TA does not). Leading team leads or managers is a strong plus.

- US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

- Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements (role, US state, salary) and walk through exactly how you filled them. There WILL be a detailed walkthrough on the interview.

- Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

- Excellent spoken English — you screen US healthcare professionals and coach everyone who does; live spoken check included.

- Fluent with ATS platforms, modern sourcing, and delivery metrics; can build a KPI dashboard, not just read one.

- Can work the fixed US night shift long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



**Do NOT apply if:** your leadership is in-house corporate TA/HR (not agency delivery); you've led sourcing/CV-mining teams only and never owned submittals-to-fill; you cannot name specific placements you personally closed; you're a pure people-manager who no longer recruits; your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US clinicians; or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



Why us: the whole delivery organization is yours — direct line to the founder, real authority over strategy, standards, and team build-out, competitive director-level base plus a placement-linked bonus tied to the fills your org produces, fully remote, long-term.



## APPLICATION QUESTIONS

1. The largest delivery organization you've led: company, your title, total headcount (and layers — did team leads/managers report to you?), what the org was measured on, and its typical monthly submittals + placements.

2. Name ONE placement you PERSONALLY closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. *(Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)*

3. Your longest single tenure at one staffing employer: company + number of months.

4. You inherit this board: ~20 open US direct-hire jobs (mostly healthcare/allied), a recruiting manager, and 2 recruiters; fill rate has been ~20%. In 5–8 sentences: your first 30 days, step by step, and the number you'd promise the founder for day 90.

5. Can you commit to a FIXED US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint) And your home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet?

6. Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), earliest start date, and a **30–60 sec voice intro** (link) introducing yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

title: Technical Marketer — Ads, Tracking (GTM/GA4), Landing Pages
description:
We are Pilot Practice (KloudMD) — a US company that builds software and marketing systems for medical practices.



This is NOT a virtual assistant job. This is NOT a social-media-poster job. If you spend your day making Canva carousels and calling that "digital marketing," do not apply.



WHO WE NEED

Someone who understands marketing AND can get their hands dirty in the tools. You do not need to be a software engineer. You DO need to be the person who can open Google Tag Manager, read a network request, find why a lead never hit the CRM, and fix it.



You will work with our US marketing team (ads + social already exist). You are the technical executor: tracking, landing pages, forms, UTMs, pixels,
 tools, and "why is this broken" diagnosis.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

- Build and QA landing pages (WordPress / HTML). Headlines, forms, mobile layout, page speed, thank-you pages.

- Own conversion tracking: Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel, Google Ads conversions, Google Ads enhanced conversions if we use them.

- Diagnose broken funnels. Ad click ? landing page ? form ? CRM. Find which hop died.

- UTM discipline. Campaign naming. So we can see which ad, which keyword, which page made the lead.

- Light ad-account work: read a Google Ads or Meta Ads account, spot wasted spend, write a one-page diagnosis. You will not be the only media buyer, but you must understand how ads work or the tracking work is useless.

- Implement, not just recommend. If you say "set up a listener on form submit," you can do it in GTM in front of me.

- Write clear notes so a non-technical teammate can follow what you changed.



MUST HAVE

- You have actually published a GTM container, not just watched a YouTube video about one.

- You can explain the difference between a pageview, a form submit event, a conversion, and a lead in a CRM — without mixing them up.

- You can look at a landing page and tell us, out loud, why it will not convert.

- You can edit WordPress (or equivalent) without breaking the header.

- Written and spoken English that a US doctor’s office would trust. We will interview on video.

- Stable internet. Night-shift overlap with Arizona, USA (MST). At least 4 hours overlap with 8am–5pm Arizona time. Full-time 40 hrs/week.



NICE TO HAVE

- Google Ads or Meta Ads you personally ran, with numbers you can talk about (spend, CPA, what you changed).

- GA4 explorations, Looker Studio, or a simple weekly report you built.

- Experience with healthcare, clinics, or any regulated lead gen (forms, disclaimers, no fake urgency).

- Basic HTML/CSS. JavaScript enough to read a dataLayer push. PHP/Laravel is a bonus, not required.



PAY AND HOURS

$7–$9 USD per hour depending on the live working test, not your resume. 40 hours/week. Paid trial (4 hours) before any long-term offer. We pay on time.



HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS OR YOU ARE AUTO-REJECTED

Most applications we get are written by ChatGPT. We will not interview those.



1) First line of your application must be exactly: WIRE-MANGO-18

2) Do not start with "I am writing to express my interest" or "I am a results-driven professional."

3) In 6–10 sentences, no bullet points, answer this in your own words:

   "A
/Meta lead ad is getting clicks. The ad account shows 22 leads. Our CRM shows 3 new contacts. Walk through how you diagnose this in the first 30 minutes. Name the exact tools and screens you open, in order. If you have done this for real, say what the actual cause was last time."

4) Paste a link to a 60–90 second video (Loom / Google Drive / unlisted YouTube). Camera on. Hold up a handwritten paper with today's date and WIRE-MANGO-18. Then talk — do not read a script — about the last tracking or landing-page problem you personally fixed. For 10 seconds, share the actual tool (GTM, GA4, Ads, WordPress) if you still have access.



If you cannot do the video, do not apply. If you use AI to write answer #3, we will know in the live interview and we will end the call.



We hire the person who can do the work on a shared screen, not the person with the prettiest cover letter.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are a Swedish e-commerce company with multiple brands, and we are looking for a **full-time Creative Strategist / Video Editor** to join our growing creative team.



You do NOT need 10 years of experience. But you should have worked with performance creatives before and understand what makes an ad convert.



### What you will do



* Research customers, competitors, reviews and winning ads

* Find strong angles, desires, problems and hooks

* Turn research into high-converting scripts

* Source or create the material needed for the ads

* Edit complete Meta ad creatives yourself

* Analyze creative performance and understand WHY something worked or failed

* Use those learnings to create better iterations and new winners



We are not looking for someone who can simply edit a nice-looking video.



We want someone who understands **performance marketing and creative strategy**.



### The Brand



You will initially work with **Scarlet Intimates**, one of our Scandinavian e-commerce brands selling leak-proof period underwear.



Our two largest customer groups are:



**1. Mothers buying for their daughters**



Our biggest angle is mothers preparing their daughters for their first period. They want their daughter to feel prepared, confident and protected instead of worrying about leaks, pads or getting her first period unexpectedly.



**2. Adult women**



Women looking for a better alternative to pads. Something that looks and feels more like normal underwear while being comfortable, dry and reliable against leaks.



It removes the wet, bulky and uncomfortable feeling many women experience with pads while also being a nicer-looking, reusable and more economical solution.



Understanding the customer deeply and turning these desires and problems into strong advertising is a major part of this job.



### IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



Before writing anything else in your application, your FIRST line must be:



**PURPLE BANANA | [the city you currently live in] | [your favorite food] | [the editing software you personally use the most]**



Example format only:



PURPLE BANANA | Your City | Your Favorite Food | Your Editing Software



Do not copy the example answers.



We added this because we only want applications from people who have actually read the entire job post.



**If your application does not start with this line, we will not review it.**



### Paid Test



Before we hire you, you will complete **2 finished test creatives**.



We will provide you with a detailed test brief containing information about the brand, customers and existing research.



However, we also expect you to **do your own research**.



You are responsible for taking the brief and turning it into two complete ads, including:



* Research

* Angle/hook

* Script

* Voiceover if needed

* Sourcing or creating footage

* AI-generated material if needed

* Editing

* Final finished advertisement



The test pays **$50 total if the test brief has been properly followed.**



This is important:



**Do NOT treat these as quick test videos.**



We want to see the exact quality you would deliver if you were already working for us full-time.



If you normally would spend additional time researching, finding better footage, improving the hook or creating better assets, then do that in the test too.



We are not looking for the bare minimum.



We want to see your **best actual working standard from day one**.



You can use tools such as:



ChatGPT, Claude, Nano Banana Pro, ElevenLabs, Kling and other AI or editing tools.



For the test, you are responsible for the tools you choose to use.



**If you are hired, we will provide the AI tools needed for your ongoing work.**



### Long-Term Opportunity



We already have another Creative Strategist working with us and we are now building a larger creative team.



This is not a short freelance project.



We are looking for someone who can work with us **full-time and long-term, potentially for years.**



Starting salary is:



**$400–$750/month + performance bonuses**



If your creatives perform well, there is room to:



* Earn performance bonuses

* Increase your salary

* Take on more responsibility

* Work on additional brands

* Grow into a larger role within the company



We care much more about **how good you are and how quickly you improve** than how many years of experience you have.



We are looking for a hidden A-player who understands advertising, takes the work seriously and wants to become extremely good at creating winning e-commerce creatives.

title: Sales Operations Admin Assistant
description:
We're a fast-growing sales organization looking for a Sales Operations Admin Assistant to support a global closer/setter team. You'll be the operational backbone keeping our pipeline clean, our calendars running, and our prospect calls happening on time.



This is a high-volume, high-responsibility role — expect 50-60 hours/week. We move fast and the pipeline doesn't stop, so we need someone who thrives with a full plate and wants to grow with a serious sales operation, not someone looking for light part-time work. In exchange, you'll get consistent full-time income, a real seat inside a functioning sales team, and room to take on more as you prove yourself.



SHIFT: Start time 6:00 AM EST. This is a hard requirement — the morning workflow below has to be complete before our first sales calls begin at 8-9 AM EST.



DAILY WORKFLOW:

1. No-show/cancellation report — review every no-show and cancellation from the prior day (conversation history + call transcript), write a short summary of what happened and why, note whether a reschedule/objection-overcome attempt was made

2. Inbox check — review responses needed and status changes on leads; pass messages into the appropriate team channel (you will not be responding to prospects directly until fully trained)

3. Calendar grading — build a chronological list of every closer's calls for the day with timestamps, mark each confirmed/unconfirmed, score lead quality 1-10, flag calendar conflicts (double bookings, overlapping calls, personal blocks with a call on top)

4. Appointment switching — move the highest-quality leads onto the best-fit closers' calendars

5. Daily report — send a report to the team channel per closer: lead, time, status, quality score, notes

6. Same-day confirmations — begin no later than 9 AM EST, ideally 8 AM EST



ONGOING (after morning block):

- Work no-shows and reschedules by calling, oldest first: yesterday, 2 days ago, 3 days ago, up to 6 days ago, plus long-term hot follow-ups



REACTIVE (can interrupt the above at any time):

- Speed to lead — if a new lead hasn't been called within 5 minutes, check the inbox and pass along immediately

- Handle cancels/reschedules as they happen — get the lead back on the calendar or at minimum set up the objection to be addressed, then pass to the right closer/setter

- Ongoing inbox monitoring — pass messages into the right channel as they come in, tagged to the right person



REQUIREMENTS:

- 1-2 years of experience in a sales operations, admin, or virtual assistant role

- Excellent organizational skills — you'll be managing multiple moving pieces simultaneously without dropping the ball

- Clear, fluent spoken English with neutral pronunciation — you'll be on the phone with US prospects daily, so easy comprehension for a US caller is essential

- Strong written English as well

- Experience with CRM platforms

- Reliable internet, quiet work environment, backup power/internet a plus

- Must be online by 6:00 AM EST daily, full-time 50-60 hrs/week



NICE TO HAVE:

- Prior sales experience (not required, but a plus — especially outbound calling or appointment setting)

- Experience supporting a sales team specifically (not just general admin)

- Familiarity with outbound/inbound call handling



HOW TO APPLY:

Submit your resume along with:

1. A short video (2 min) introducing yourself and your relevant experience

2. Your available start date

3. Your expected monthly salary (USD)



We respond only to applicants who follow these instructions exactly — this is how we screen for attention to detail.

I’ll provide the business knowledge, pricing and direction. I’m looking for someone who can take that information, execute it well, keep things organised and eventually learn the business well enough to identify things that need attention without waiting for me to create every task.



The role will initially be approximately 3–5 hours per week for a 4-week paid trial.



If we work well together, I’d like this to become an ongoing role with increased responsibility over time.



THE FIRST PROJECT



Our immediate goal is:



Get Heartwood Hire’s digital shopfront looking fantastic and working properly before an important regional tourism industry event in October.



We already have an established Wix website.



I am not looking to migrate the website to another platform or rebuild the business from scratch.



I need someone who can work confidently within Wix and improve what we already have.



WHAT YOU’LL HELP WITH



Wix Website



* Audit our existing Wix website on desktop and mobile

* Update and improve existing pages

* Create new pages where required

* Improve page layouts and presentation

* Update products, pricing, photographs and descriptions

* Create pages for new wedding, event and corporate hire packages

* Improve website navigation

* Improve calls to action

* Improve enquiry forms and customer pathways

* Check and improve mobile presentation

* Assist with basic Wix SEO, page titles and descriptions

* Keep website information current



Digital Marketing & Content



* Organise our existing business photo library

* Identify our strongest photographs for marketing

* Create attractive Canva marketing materials

* Create and schedule quality Instagram and
 content

* Organise and publish customer testimonials and event photographs

* Help create a professional digital hire catalogue

* Help create business capability documents

* Assist with updated business cards and QR codes

* Keep branding and business information consistent across platforms



Business Development & Research



* Research wedding venues and event businesses

* Research accommodation and tourism operators

* Identify potential referral and B2B partners

* Maintain contact and prospect databases

* Research relevant tourism and business opportunities

* Help maintain regional tourism and business listings

* Assist with developing marketing material for venue partners and corporate clients



Systems & Administration



* Help improve enquiry and follow-up processes

* Create and maintain useful spreadsheets and databases

* Organise digital files and photographs

* Help create reusable templates

* Keep product, pricing and marketing information organised and current

* General digital marketing and online business administration as required



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR



You don’t need to know everything.



But you do need to be someone who figures things out.



I’m particularly looking for someone who:



* Has strong hands-on Wix experience

* Can show examples of Wix websites or pages they’ve personally worked on

* Understands Wix’s mobile editor, forms, basic SEO and page design

* Has excellent written English

* Is highly organised

* Can work independently

* Is confident using Canva

* Understands Instagram and
 for small businesses

* Has a good eye for design, photography and presentation

* Is comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT productively

* Is confident using Google Drive, Docs and Sheets

* Can research businesses and opportunities online

* Communicates clearly when something requires a decision

* Notices problems and suggests solutions

* Can follow instructions without needing constant supervision

* Actually finishes things



Experience working with Australian businesses, weddings, events, tourism, hospitality or accommodation would be a big advantage.



WIX EXPERIENCE



Because Heartwood Hire already has an established Wix website, Wix experience is strongly preferred.



I’m not looking to pay someone to learn Wix from scratch.



If you’ve worked with Wix, please show me examples and explain exactly what work you personally completed.



If your Wix experience is limited, please be upfront about it.



HOURS & PAY



Initially:



3–5 hours per week



AUD $20–$30 per hour depending on experience and capability.



I’m open to discussing the rate with an exceptional candidate.



The position will begin with a 4-week paid trial.



If you’re a great fit, there is potential for ongoing work, additional hours and increased responsibility.



I’m looking for someone who could eventually become a trusted part of the business rather than someone who simply completes a single website project and disappears.



HOW TO APPLY



Please start your application with the word:



HEARTWOOD



If HEARTWOOD isn’t the first word of your application, I will assume you haven’t read the job advertisement.



Then please answer the following:



1. Tell me briefly about yourself and where you’re based.

2. What is your hourly rate in Australian dollars (AUD)?

3. How many hours are you currently available each week?

4. Tell me about your Wix experience.

5. Please provide links to Wix websites or pages you’ve personally worked on and explain what work you completed on them.

6. Tell me about your Canva experience and provide examples if available.

7. Tell me about your experience managing social media for small businesses.

8. Have you worked with Australian businesses before? If so, tell me a little about that experience.

9. Please provide links or examples of three pieces of work you’ve personally completed that you think demonstrate your ability.

10. Tell me about one problem you noticed while working with a small business and what you did to solve it.

11. Which AI tools do you currently use? Give me one real example of how you use AI to make your work better or more efficient.

12. If you looked at a small-business website and thought it needed significant improvement, how would you decide what to fix first?



ONE LAST THING



Please don’t send me a generic AI-generated cover letter.



I’m perfectly happy for you to use AI in your work — in fact, I encourage it.



But I want to hear enough of you in your application to understand how you think, communicate and solve problems.



I’m not looking for the person who writes the fanciest application or charges the lowest hourly rate.



I’m looking for someone who is reliable, capable, organised, proactive and easy to work with — someone who would genuinely enjoy helping an Australian small business become more organised and grow.



If that sounds like you, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor and Brand Content Manager (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Company: Ryan Rivard / BSPKN Location: Remote, Philippines (metro area preferred) Type: Full-Time Compensation: $650 USD per month to start, with growth based on performance Start Date: Immediate, with a paid 2-week trial



ABOUT RYAN RIVARD



Ryan Rivard is an executive coach, endurance athlete, and content creator with 226,000 Instagram followers. He summited Mount Everest in May 2024, completed Ironman Madison and the Leadville 100 MTB, and coaches high-performing founders and executives through The Dodek Method. Ryan partners with leading performance and wellness brands. His content spans endurance training, mindset, brand partnerships, family, and recovery. We are looking for one strong person who can both edit high-quality video and manage the day-to-day content operation.



THE ROLE



This is a combined creative and operational role. You are responsible for turning raw footage into polished, scroll-stopping content and for keeping the content engine organized and consistent. This is not a passive posting job. You own the quality of what goes out and the rhythm of how it gets there.



The two halves of this role are equally important. If you are a brilliant editor but disorganized, this is not your role. If you are highly organized but cannot edit compelling video, this is not your role. We need both.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Edit 15 to 25 Instagram Reels per month from raw footage into polished, on-brand video with clean pacing, strong hooks, text overlays, captions, music, and transitions.

Produce both high-production brand partnership content and authentic, casual content, and know when each is appropriate.

Maintain consistent brand aesthetics across all static posts, carousels, and video. Colors, fonts, and style must match the brand guidelines every time.

Organize raw footage in Google Drive into the correct category folders as it comes in.

Build and maintain the weekly content calendar and keep posting consistent across Instagram, with TikTok and YouTube Shorts to follow.

Communicate proactively. Provide a clear weekly update on what is done, what is coming, and what you need.

Meet with Ryan once per week for a 30-minute sync to review what is working, what needs improvement, and priorities for the week ahead.



REQUIREMENTS



Minimum 2 years editing short-form video for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts. Portfolio required.

Proficiency in a professional editing platform such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro.

Strong design sense for maintaining consistent brand aesthetics across all content.

Excellent written English for captions and communication.

Highly organized, proactive, and reliable. You follow through without being chased.

Available during US Central Time with at least 3 hours of overlap daily, and available for a weekly 30-minute video call with Ryan.



HOW TO APPLY



Submit the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



Your portfolio or reel with at least 3 examples of short-form video you personally edited. This is required. We need to see real proof of your editing quality, pacing, and hooks.

One example of a branded or product-focused video you edited, so we can see how you handle brand content.

A brief paragraph of 3 to 5 sentences on how you keep a content operation organized and consistent.

A 60-second video introduction. Show your editing workspace, walk us through one edit you are proud of, and tell us what raw footage you started with and what decisions you made.



IMPORTANT: To confirm you have read this entire description, title your application "morning summit." Applications without this exact title will not be reviewed.

title: B2B Cold Caller & Appointment Setter | GoHighLevel Experience Required

This is a long-term part-time position for 20–30 hours per week, with the possibility of growing into a full-time role.



YOUR PRIMARY OBJECTIVE



Your main responsibility is to connect with restaurant owners, General Managers, Managing Partners, or other decision-makers and:



1. Schedule a confirmed appointment for our local Sales Representative, or

2. If a direct appointment is not possible, identify the correct decision-maker and determine the best day and time for our Sales Representative to visit the restaurant.



We will initially provide restaurant lists, including restaurant names, addresses, phone numbers, and, in many cases, the owner’s name.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Make outbound B2B calls to restaurants in New York City and Long Island.

• Ask for the restaurant owner, General Manager, or person responsible for business partnerships.

• Deliver a short and professional introduction to FRAMELAB Hospitality.

• Navigate gatekeepers confidently and professionally.

• Confirm that the decision-maker understands the purpose of the meeting.

• Confirm appointments before the Sales Representative visits.

• Perform consistent follow-ups by phone and
.

• Keep all restaurant and decision-maker information accurate and organized inside the CRM.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Proven experience with B2B cold calling.

• Proven experience with appointment setting.

• Real hands-on experience using GoHighLevel CRM.

• Clear, confident, and professional spoken English.

• Experience speaking with business owners and decision-makers.

• Ability to handle gatekeepers and objections.

• Strong organization and accurate CRM documentation.

• Reliable internet connection, quality headset, and quiet working environment.

• Ability to work during New York business hours, Eastern Time.



Restaurant, hospitality, local business, or U.S. B2B calling experience is strongly preferred.



HOW PERFORMANCE WILL BE MEASURED



• Qualified appointments scheduled with actual decision-makers.

• Percentage of appointments that are confirmed and completed.

• Decision-maker information collected.

• Follow-ups completed on time.

• Accuracy of all information entered into GoHighLevel.



You will not be responsible for closing the restaurant partnership. Our local Sales Representative will visit the restaurant, conduct the full presentation, and close the deal.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



• Restaurant lead lists.

• Sales script and training.

• GoHighLevel CRM access.

• Company calling system.

• Information about our service and existing restaurant partnerships.

• Base compensation plus performance bonuses.

• Opportunity for stable, long-term employment.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word “RESTAURANT” and answer the following questions:

2. Which industries and U.S. businesses have you called?

title: Recruitment Delivery Manager — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
US-based direct-hire staffing firm (healthcare/allied-health core, expanding into new verticals) is hiring a Recruitment Delivery Manager — a player-coach who owns our open-job board end-to-end and is accountable for filling it. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder.



This is not a sourcing-team or coordinator seat. You take the list of open US jobs, build the fill strategy for each one (sourcing channels, candidate pool, pay-band reality, timeline), personally recruit on the priority searches — sourcing, screening, and submitting candidates yourself — and build and coach a small delivery team as volume grows. You own the number: qualified submittals per week and jobs filled.



Responsibilities

- Own the open-req board: triage every US job, build a written per-req fill strategy, and keep every req moving or call it honestly.

- Personally work the priority desks full-cycle: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit qualified candidates to US clients.

- Drive the delivery standard — quality-gated submittals per recruiter per week — with every candidate recruiter-screened before submission, no resume-blasting.

- Recruit, onboard, and coach delivery recruiters as the board requires; run the daily delivery cadence and report fill metrics weekly to the founder.

- Tell the truth with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



Required

- 4+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, including 2+ years leading a delivery team that was measured on submittals and placements (not a sourcing-only or admin team). US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

- Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements you made (role, US state, salary) and walk through how you filled them. There WILL be a detailed walkthrough on the interview.

- Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

## APPLICATION QUESTIONS

2. Name ONE placement you PERSONALLY closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. *(Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)*

title: Cabinet Engineer/Shop Drawing Specialist
description:
Cabinet Engineer / Shop Drawing Specialist — Remote (Philippines)



Company: Selhorst Woodworks — Custom Millwork & Finish Carpentry (Las Vegas, NV, USA) Type: Full-time, remote, long-term Pay: $275 USD per week Start date: Immediately



About Us



We are a custom millwork and finish carpentry shop in Las Vegas, Nevada. We specialize in custom wall units, mud rooms, entertainment built-ins, and other architectural millwork. Everything we make is custom — no catalog boxes, no repeat SKUs. Our shop drawings have to be right the first time, because a mistake on paper becomes an expensive mistake in wood.



We are looking for one experienced cabinet engineer to join our team long-term.



The Role



You will take approved designs and field measurements and turn them into complete, buildable shop drawings that our shop can cut and assemble without asking questions.



Day to day, you will:



Model complete cabinet runs and individual casework in Fusion 360

Produce shop drawings: plans, elevations, sections, and detail views with full dimensions

Generate cut lists and panel/part breakdowns for the shop

Specify joinery, construction methods, panel materials, edgebanding, and hardware

Lay out doors, drawer fronts, and reveals; call out overlays, gaps, and finished ends

Detail hardware placement — hinges, slides, lift systems, pulls, adjustable shelving

Coordinate with our designers and project managers on revisions and field changes

Flag design problems before they hit the shop floor — bad clearances, out-of-square wall conditions, impossible reveals

What You Must Have

Real cabinet and custom cabinet experience. You have engineered custom casework before, not just furniture or general product design.

Fusion 360 proficiency you already have. You can model, assemble, and produce dimensioned drawings today, with no training period.

You understand frameless cabinet construction. We build euro frameless only — no face frame. 32mm system, full overlay, box construction, joinery methods, sheet goods, edgebanding, hardware sizing, and how tolerances stack up.

You can read and work from architectural drawings and field measurements.

File-exchange fluency. You can reliably import and export between Fusion 360 and AutoCAD and SketchUp — DWG, DXF, STEP — and keep dimensions, layers, and scale intact through the round trip. Our upstream drawings come to you in AutoCAD and SketchUp, and this cannot be a weak spot.

Strong written English. Almost all of our coordination happens in writing.

Reliable internet, a computer that runs Fusion 360 comfortably, and a quiet place to work.

Availability to overlap with Las Vegas business hours (Pacific Time) for part of your day.

Strongly Preferred

Hands-on shop experience actually building cabinets. If you have run a saw, assembled boxes, or installed casework, we want to talk to you first.

Experience preparing files for CNC — nesting, part labeling, machining callouts

Experience working with a US-based shop or US construction standards

Comfort working in imperial units (inches and fractions) — this is how all of our drawings are dimensioned

Who This Is Not For

Anyone who needs to learn Fusion 360 on the job

General 3D modelers or renderers with no cabinet background

Anyone who cannot commit to a consistent full-time weekly schedule

Compensation and Terms

$275 USD per week, paid weekly

Full-time, long-term position with room to grow as our volume grows

Paid time off after an initial trial period

Work is 100% remote

How to Apply



Send an application that includes all of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.



A short introduction — where you have worked, and what kind of cabinets you engineered there.

Portfolio or work samples of cabinet shop drawings you personally produced. PDFs are fine. If your past work is confidential, send anything you own or have created on your own.

Confirmation of your years of Fusion 360 experience and what you use it for.

Whether you have hands-on shop or installation experience, and where.

A description of how you move files between Fusion 360 and AutoCAD or SketchUp — which formats you use and what you watch out for.

Your computer specs and internet speed.

Your available working hours in Pacific Time.

Start the first line of your message with the word DOVETAIL so we know you read this posting completely.



Qualified applicants will be given a short paid test project — one real cabinet drawn to our standard — before hire.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter — US Storm Damage Roofing (Base + Bonus + Commission)
description:
Read this whole post. There are specific application instructions at the bottom, and I delete anything that doesn't follow them.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're a US-based agency that works with roofing contractors. When a hailstorm hits a neighborhood, we call the homeowners in that area, let them know their roof may have storm damage that their insurance covers, and offer them a free inspection from our contractor.



You are the person making those calls.



This is not a read-the-script-and-hang-up job. You're the first human voice these homeowners hear about something that could save them thousands of dollars. Your job is to get them interested, qualify them properly, book them onto the contractor's calendar, and make sure they actually show up.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Call homeowners in recently storm-affected US zip codes from lists we provide (you are not finding your own leads)

- Explain that their area was hit and that storm damage is often covered by their homeowner's insurance

- Qualify them: age of roof, do they own the home, do they currently carry homeowner's insurance, has another contractor or adjuster already inspected the roof, plus a few more we'll train you on

- Book qualified homeowners directly onto our contractor's calendar

- Follow up by call and text before the appointment so the homeowner actually shows

- Log every call outcome in the CRM (GoHighLevel — we'll train you)

- Report your numbers daily: dials, contacts, qualified, booked



WHO THIS IS FOR



- You've done outbound cold calling to US consumers before and it doesn't scare you

- Clear, easy-to-understand English on the phone. Homeowners are often older. If they have to say "sorry, what?" twice, the call is lost.

- You can take fifty no's in a row and dial number fifty-one with the same energy

- You listen more than you talk, and you can think on your feet when someone goes off-script

- You're organized enough to keep a calendar clean and follow up without being reminded



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



- Anyone whose experience is inbound support,
, or general admin VA work

- Anyone who needs to be micromanaged

- Anyone who can't commit to US hours

- Anyone sending the same copy-paste message to fifty job posts today



HOURS



Important: our calling zones change depending on where storms hit, so hours shift with the campaign — sometimes US Eastern, sometimes Central, sometimes Pacific. In practice, you're working nights Philippine time, generally between 9PM and 9AM PHT, around 40 hours a week. If you can't reliably commit to a night shift that occasionally moves by a few hours, this role won't work for you.



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



- 20 Mbps minimum, stable, wired connection preferred

- Backup internet (pocket wifi or mobile data) and backup power. Dropped calls mid-pitch cost us money.

- A quiet, dedicated workspace with no background noise on calls

- Noise-cancelling USB headset

- A computer that runs a browser-based dialer and CRM without lag



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Fresh, storm-verified lead lists

- Dialer and CRM

- Scripts, rebuttals, and the qualifying framework

- Training and call reviews. We will coach you, and we expect you to be coachable.



HOW TO APPLY



Follow these exactly.



1. Start your message with the word HAILSTORM. If it's not the first word, I won't read the rest.



2. In 3-4 sentences, tell me about the outbound campaign you're proudest of. What were you selling, who were you calling, what were your numbers?



3. Record a voice sample about 60 seconds long (Google Drive link, Loom, or any audio file). Introduce yourself, then pretend I'm a homeowner in Dallas whose neighborhood just got hit by hail, and pitch me on a free roof inspection. Improvise it. I'm judging clarity, warmth, and whether you sound like a real person instead of a robot.



4. Tell me your internet speed and whether you have backup power.



5. Tell me the earliest date you can start.



Applications without a voice sample get deleted unread.



I'm hiring one person and I'm willing to wait for the right one. If that's you, show me.

Haze Photo and Film is a wedding photography and videography studio based in Australia looking for a freelance video editor for ongoing, per-project work. We handle all filming. You'll receive raw footage and edit it into finished wedding films.



**How it works:**



We send you the raw footage and audio from each wedding. Before editing, we'll debrief the day with you by call or
 and give you direction on story, tone, standout moments to build the edit around and priorities from the couple. 



**Responsibilities:**

- Colour grade and colour correct footage shot across varying light, from outdoor ceremonies to dim reception venues, so the whole film feels visually consistent.

- Choose music that matches the couple's taste and the emotional beats of the day, from quiet vow moments to high energy reception cuts.

- Structure the edit for pacing, deciding what stays, what gets trimmed, and how scenes flow into each other to tell a cohesive story.

- Cut multiple deliverables from the same footage, including a highlight film, a longer documentary style edit, and short vertical cuts for social media.

- Organise and manage large volumes of raw footage without losing or mixing up files between projects. Take feedback from us and the couple and turn revision notes into a refined final cut within the agreed timeline.



**Requirements:**



At least 1 year prior experience editing wedding films, with a portfolio to show. Fluent in written and spoken English. Fluent in DaVinci Resolve. Strong musicality and a natural sense of storytelling, this role leans heavily on music selection and pacing. Experience with multicam and audio syncing. Comfortable transferring and managing large video files (Dropbox, Google Drive, LucidLink, or similar). Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines.

Freelance, ongoing per-project work. Rate to be discussed based on experience and turnaround.

title: Digital Marketing Executive Assistant To The CEO
description:
================

THE SHORT VERSION

================



You will work side by side with the CEO of an Inc. 5000 performance marketing agency, turning half-formed ideas into clear plans, organized projects, and finished work.



If you already understand how paid ads, funnels,
, and CRM workflows fit together, and you are the kind of person who moves projects forward without being chased, keep reading.



If you are looking for calendar management and inbox cleanup, this is not that job...



===================

ABOUT WRK MARKETING

===================



WRK Marketing is a performance marketing agency serving ecommerce and lead generation clients across the US. We build marketing systems, launch campaigns, improve funnels, manage paid traffic, produce creative, test offers, and grow revenue for our clients.



We move fast. Priorities shift. The work is real and it shifts too.



========================

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

========================



The CEO generates more ideas and priorities than any one person can execute. Your job is to catch them, structure them, and drive them to done.



In a typical week, you might:



- Take a rough concept from a voice note or a five-minute call and turn it into a scoped plan with owners, deadlines, and deliverables

- Build out and maintain projects in ClickUp, then keep them honest as things change

- Manage the agency's
 marketing calendar and coordinate the assets that feed it

- Push a funnel or landing page project forward across designers, copywriters, and media buyers

- Follow up with team members and contractors, surface what is stuck, and unblock it

- Research and evaluate a new tool, then write a short recommendation

- Clean up an internal workflow or document a process that only lives in someone's head

- Prep briefs, agendas, and materials so the CEO walks into every meeting ready



The mix changes based on what the business needs most that month. Flexibility is part of the job description.



======================

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

======================



FIRST 30 DAYS

You know our tools, our clients, our team, and our project structure. Nothing the CEO hands you gets dropped.

BY 90 DAYS

The CEO stops tracking status manually because you already know it. Projects have owners and dates. Follow-ups happen without reminders.

BY SIX MONTHS

You are catching problems before they surface and proposing solutions rather than waiting for direction. You own entire workstreams end to end.



=====================

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

=====================



REAL DIGITAL MARKETING DEPTH

Not expert-level in everything, but you need to understand how the pieces connect: paid ads, funnels, landing pages,
 marketing, lead generation, ecommerce, CRM workflows, automation, reporting, creative strategy, and campaign planning. You should be able to sit in a strategy conversation and follow it without a glossary.

EXCELLENT WRITTEN & SPOKEN COMMUNICATION

You can write a clear update in four sentences. You can explain what is done, what is blocked, what needs a decision, and what happens next. You ask sharp questions instead of guessing.

GENUINE OWNERSHIP

You follow up with people who outrank you. You chase the thing you were told about three weeks ago. You do not go quiet.

COMFORT WITH SOFTWARE

You can open a platform you have never used, figure out what it does, and be productive in it quickly.

STRONG PLUSES

Agency experience. Project management experience. Team leadership experience. Direct experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive.



======================

TOOLS YOU MIGHT TOUCH

======================



ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets), GoHighLevel or similar CRMs, Klaviyo and other
 platforms, funnel and landing page builders, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Shopify, AgencyAnalytics or similar reporting dashboards, Canva, Figma, CapCut, and AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Descript, and ElevenLabs.



Hands-on experience with ClickUp, Klaviyo, GoHighLevel, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and Shopify is a major advantage.



==========================

Automated
 flows.

Brand development.

Marketing

Content creation

title: Podcast Relationship & Sponsorship Assistant
description:
**Part-Time | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity**



 About Us



Unshackled Moms Alliance is a growing education and coaching community supporting mothers of tweens and teens through honest conversations, practical resources, small groups, studies, one-on-one coaching, and The Unshackled Moms Alliance Podcast.



Our podcast features meaningful conversations with professionals, authors, advocates, parents, and people with lived experience. We talk about subjects that matter, including parenting, mental health, family relationships, trauma, faith, identity, and the complicated realities families face.



We are looking for a Podcast Relationship & Sponsorship Assistant who can help us take excellent care of our guests while also developing relationships with businesses and organizations that are a strong fit for podcast sponsorships.



This is not primarily a social media or video editing position. We are looking for someone whose strengths are communication, relationship building, follow-up, organization, and outreach.



What You'll Be Responsible For:



1.  Podcast Guest Relationships



You will help manage the guest experience from initial invitation through post-interview follow-up.



Responsibilities include:



* Sending podcast guest invitations using our established outreach sequence

* Following up with potential guests who have not responded

* Helping coordinate interview scheduling and rescheduling

* Sending weekly reminders to upcoming podcast guests

* Keeping guest information and podcast status organized

* Communicating warmly and professionally with guests

* Following up after interviews

* Maintaining our guest pipeline so potential guests do not get lost in the shuffle



Our guests often share personal or sensitive stories. We want every guest to feel like a person we value, not an appointment on a calendar.



2. Sponsorship Relationships



You will also help grow the sponsorship side of the podcast.



Responsibilities include:



* Researching businesses, organizations, and brands that may be a good fit for our audience

* Identifying the appropriate contact person

* Sending personalized sponsorship outreach

* Following up consistently with prospective sponsors

* Sharing sponsorship information and answering basic questions

* Keeping track of conversations, follow-ups, commitments, and renewals

* Maintaining relationships with existing sponsors

* Following up when a sponsorship is approaching renewal

* Looking for opportunities to turn one-time sponsors into ongoing relationships



We already have sponsorship packages and materials. You will not be expected to create the sponsorship program from scratch.



We are especially interested in someone who enjoys outreach and is comfortable helping turn conversations into partnerships.



Who We're Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



* Write excellent conversational English

* Communicate warmly and professionally

* Are naturally good at building relationships

* Are organized and dependable

* Follow up without needing to be reminded

* Are comfortable sending cold and warm outreach
s

* Can keep track of multiple conversations at different stages

* Notice when someone hasn't responded and know it's time to follow up

* Are comfortable talking about sponsorship opportunities and money

* Can personalize communication rather than simply copying and pasting the same message to everyone

* Understand that good relationship management means making people feel genuinely cared for

* Are comfortable working independently once systems and expectations are established



Previous experience with podcasting, sponsorship outreach, influencer outreach, lead generation, sales, partnership development, guest booking, or relationship management would be especially valuable.



You do NOT need to have experience in all of these areas.



This Position Is NOT



This is not a full-time social media manager position.



This is not primarily a graphic design or video editing position.



This is not a bookkeeping position.



This is not a high-pressure sales position where success means sending hundreds of generic cold
s.



We care much more about thoughtful outreach, consistent follow-up, and genuine relationships.



Hours & Long-Term Potential



This will begin as a part-time position.



We are building a long-term team and are looking for someone who wants to learn the organization, develop ownership of this role, and grow with us rather than simply complete a temporary project.



As the podcast and sponsorship program grow, there may be opportunities for the position to grow as well.



 Compensation



Hourly compensation will be based on experience.



Because sponsorship development directly contributes to the growth of the organization, we are also interested in offering a performance incentive/commission for sponsorships you help secure.



Details will be discussed with selected candidates.



 How to Apply



Please send a short response answering these questions:



1. Tell me about any experience you have with podcast guest management, outreach, lead generation, sponsorships, sales, or relationship management.



2. Imagine you
ed a potential podcast sponsor and they did not respond. What would your follow-up process look like?



3. Which part of this position sounds most interesting to you: guest relationships, sponsorship outreach, or both? Why?



4. Tell me about a time you had to keep track of several people or conversations that were all at different stages.



5. What hourly rate are you looking for?



Please begin your application with the words **“I read the whole post.”**



We don't need the person with the longest résumé.



We need someone who is warm, organized, persistent, resourceful, and genuinely good with people.

title: Full-Time WFH Client Success Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.
