title: YouTube Video Editor for Dog Challenge Content | High Retention, SFX & Motion Graphics
description:
YouTube Editor | High Retention, SFX & Motion Graphics



We’re looking for a creative and experienced YouTube editor to work on entertaining long form dog challenge videos



Our videos will be built around public challenges, games, reactions and dog related entertainment. We want the editing to feel fast, engaging and professional, with a strong focus on keeping viewers watching.



An example concept is “Match the Dog With the Dog Owner”, where members of the public have to work out which dog belongs to which owner across multiple rounds.



Editing Style



We’re looking for an energetic, high retention YouTube editing style inspired by large entertainment and challenge channels such as MrBeast, while still creating our own recognisable style.



The editing should include:



* Strong opening hooks

* Fast paced cuts

* Punch ins and zooms

* Sound effects

* Background music throughout

* Music changes based on the mood of each scene

* Animated text and pop ups

* Correct and incorrect answer animations

* Scoreboards

* Round counters

* Progress graphics

* Suspense effects before reveals

* Reaction cuts

* Funny moments highlighted through editing

* Memes where appropriate

* Motion graphics

* Dog and owner name graphics

* On screen questions

* Challenge rules displayed clearly

* Countdown timers where appropriate

* Transitions between rounds

* Visual callouts and arrows

* B roll placement

* Strong storytelling throughout

* Removal of unnecessary pauses or slow sections

* Clean colour correction

* Professional audio balancing

* Noise reduction where required



Effects should improve the video rather than being added randomly. We want the videos to feel energetic without becoming overwhelming.



What We Need From You



You should be comfortable taking raw footage and turning it into a complete YouTube video rather than simply following a cut list.



We need someone who can:



* Understand the story and structure of the footage

* Identify the funniest and strongest moments

* Build tension around challenge reveals

* Know when a section needs shortening

* Keep conversations engaging

* Create strong pacing throughout the entire video

* Add graphics without needing every animation explained

* Suggest improvements when you see opportunities

* Understand YouTube audience retention

* Understand entertainment and challenge content

* Keep the editing style consistent between episodes



You should be able to make creative decisions independently while still following our overall direction.



Requirements



Ideally you will have:



* Previous experience editing YouTube videos

* Experience with challenge, entertainment or creator content

* Strong motion graphics skills

* Strong sound design

* Good understanding of music selection

* Good comedic timing

* Understanding of YouTube retention and pacing

* Professional editing software such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro

* Reliable communication

* Ability to meet agreed deadlines

* Good attention to detail

* Ability to follow feedback accurately



You must also use properly licensed music, sound effects, graphics and other assets so the finished videos are safe to publish and monetise on YouTube.



Workflow



We will provide the raw footage, audio and any relevant information about the concept.



You would then:



1. Review and organise the footage

2. Create the story and main edit

3. Remove weak or unnecessary sections

4. Add music and sound design

5. Add graphics, text, pop ups and animations

6. Add challenge specific elements such as scores and round counters

7. Complete colour and audio finishing

8. Send the first draft for review

9. Complete agreed revisions

10. Deliver the final YouTube ready video



We would also like the project files to remain organised in case changes are required later.



Revisions



The budget should include reasonable revisions following the first draft.



We’re looking for someone who takes feedback well and can make changes accurately without needing repeated explanations.



Budget



Our budget is approximately £200 to £350 GBP per finished YouTube video, depending on:



* Video length

* Editing complexity

* Experience

* Motion graphics required

* Quality of previous work



We’re looking for quality rather than simply finding the cheapest editor.



Long Term Opportunity



This is not intended to be a one off project.



If the first videos go well, we would like to build a long term relationship with an editor who can become familiar with our style and work on future YouTube videos regularly.



When Applying



Please send:



* Your best YouTube editing examples

* Any challenge or entertainment videos you have edited

* Examples showing motion graphics and sound design

* Your usual price per video

* What video length your price covers

* Your usual turnaround time

* What software you edit with

* How many revisions are included

* Whether you are available for regular ongoing work



Please only apply if you can achieve the type of high retention editing described above.



If your portfolio includes challenge videos, public interaction content, game show style content or MrBeast inspired editing, please send those examples first.

title: High-End Personal Brand Video Editor — YouTube + Instagram
description:
# High-End Personal Brand Video Editor — YouTube + Instagram Reels



## The Opportunity



I'm looking for an **exceptionally talented and ambitious video editor** to join me long-term in building a high-end personal brand in the business, mindset, performance, identity, and personal-development space.



This is NOT a generic video-editing position.



I'm looking for someone who understands how the world's strongest personal brands package ideas through:



**Storytelling. Psychology. Emotion. Pacing. Hooks. Typography. Personal B-roll. Sound design. Visual identity.**



Think of the quality, retention, storytelling, and attention to detail found in creators such as:



* Iman Gadzhi

* Alex Hormozi

* Nick Setting

* SooWei Goh



The objective isn't to copy these creators.



It's to understand **why their content works** and develop our own recognizable, premium visual identity.



I don't want unnecessary effects every two seconds.



I want content that feels:



**Premium. Clean. Modern. Powerful. Emotional. Intelligent. High-value.**



Most importantly, the ideas themselves must remain at the center.



---



# Before Applying — Study the Brand



Before applying, please take some time to understand the content we're building:



**YouTube:** Hugo Christiansen 







I strongly recommend watching some of my content before submitting your application.



I don't want someone who simply knows how to edit videos.



I want someone who understands **my ideas, personality, audience, communication style, and long-term vision** — and who can eventually translate all of that into a recognizable visual identity.



If you've already been following my content before seeing this job post, please mention it in your application.



---



# What We're Building



This isn't about hiring someone to "edit some videos."



I'm building a serious personal brand and content ecosystem with the intention of becoming a major player in the business, mindset, identity, performance, and personal-development industry.



I'm looking for someone with an **insane amount of grit**.



Someone ambitious.



Someone curious.



Someone who wants responsibility.



Someone who wants to become world-class at their craft.



Someone who gets excited about building something from the early stages and eventually being able to say:



**"I helped build that."**



I want the type of person I'd genuinely enjoy sitting down and having dinner with — someone who thinks differently, cares deeply about what they create, and has ambitions far beyond simply collecting a paycheck.



If you're looking for a comfortable freelance gig where you receive footage, edit it, send it back, and forget about it...



**This probably isn't for you.**



But if you want to become an integral part of an ambitious brand and grow as the company grows, keep reading.



---



# What You'll Be Editing



We plan to publish approximately:



## YouTube



**2+ long-form YouTube videos per week**



## Instagram



**Approximately 2 Reels per day**



Most Reels will initially come from long-form content, alongside occasional original short-form content.



One of your most important responsibilities will be watching long-form videos and **independently recognizing the moments that deserve to become short-form content.**



I don't want to provide every timestamp forever.



You should eventually be able to watch a video and think:



**"THAT is the Reel."**



And understand exactly why.



---



# This Is About More Than Editing



Technical editing ability is obviously important.



But I'm equally interested in your understanding of **human psychology and emotion.**



A great editor doesn't simply make a video look pretty.



A great editor understands:



**What makes someone stop scrolling?**



**What creates curiosity?**



**Where does tension need to build?**



**Where should we slow down?**



**What moment creates emotion?**



**What makes the viewer trust the creator?**



**What makes an idea memorable?**



**What makes the right viewer eventually want to work with us?**



Our audience consists primarily of **successful founders and entrepreneurs who have already achieved significant results but know there is another level of performance, identity, and personal transformation available to them.**



We're not trying to attract everybody.



We're trying to create content that resonates deeply with the **right people**.



Views matter.



But **qualified attention, trust, the right audience, and ultimately conversions matter more.**



---



# Your Responsibilities



## Long-Form YouTube



* Turn raw footage into polished, premium YouTube videos

* Remove unnecessary pauses, repetition, mistakes, and dead space

* Improve pacing and viewer retention

* Create emotional dynamics throughout the video

* Use my personal B-roll and brand assets where appropriate

* Add tasteful graphics, text, screenshots, diagrams, and visual explanations

* Use music and sound design intelligently

* Maintain a consistent premium visual identity

* Make complex ideas easier to understand visually

* Understand when NOT to add an effect

* Help make every video feel intentional



## Short-Form Content



You will watch long-form videos and independently identify the strongest short-form opportunities.



You'll then:



* Select powerful 30–90 second sections

* Identify or construct strong opening hooks

* Package ideas specifically for short-form consumption

* Reframe footage vertically

* Add premium captions and typography

* Use my personal B-roll for visual storytelling

* Create tasteful pattern interrupts

* Improve pacing and retention

* Use sound design intelligently

* Amplify emotion without making the content feel artificial



You must understand the difference between **cutting a clip** and **packaging an idea.**



---



# Personal B-Roll & Content Library



You will have access to an organized **content bank containing my personal B-roll, lifestyle footage, previous shoots, photos, screenshots, graphics, and other brand assets.**



When adding B-roll, I want you to primarily use **my own footage and brand assets — NOT generic stock footage from the internet.**



Part of your job will be learning this content library extremely well so that when I discuss a particular idea, emotion, experience, or story, you instinctively know which visual moments from my life can reinforce it.



Over time, we'll continuously expand this library with new footage from professional shoots, travel, business, lifestyle, and everyday life.



The goal is for the content to visually communicate **my world and my brand**, rather than looking like generic internet content.



---



# Data & Content Performance



Over time, I want you to become obsessed with understanding **why certain content performs better than other content.**



Not just:



**"This Reel got more views."**



But:



**Why?**



What was the topic?



What was the hook?



What emotion did it create?



What editing choices worked?



What type of person engaged with it?



Did it generate the right followers?



Did it generate qualified conversations?



Did it ultimately contribute to sales?



We'll analyze our content and continuously improve.



The objective isn't simply **maximum views**.



The objective is building a content machine that generates:



**Attention ? Emotion ? Trust ? Authority ? Qualified Audience ? Conversion**



If analyzing that sounds exciting to you, you'll probably enjoy working with us.



---



# The Person We're Looking For



Formal education does NOT matter to me.



I don't care whether you have a bachelor's degree.



I care about:



**Taste.

Grit.

Ambition.

Creativity.

Emotional intelligence.

Psychology.

Content judgment.

English comprehension.

Reliability.

Attention to detail.

Editing ability.

Speed.

Curiosity.

Coachability.**



Ideally, you've already spent **tens or hundreds of hours consuming YouTube content about business, entrepreneurship, personal development, psychology, performance, or high-level personal brands.**



If you've spent hundreds of hours studying creators, businesses, personal brands, storytelling, and psychology because you genuinely enjoy this world, that's a major advantage.



When someone references creators like Hormozi or Gadzhi, I don't want you completely unfamiliar with the world we're operating in.



You should understand internet culture.



You should understand personal brands.



You should understand why people watch.



And your English needs to be strong enough to understand nuanced conversations about business, psychology, identity, performance, and personal development.



---



# The Long-Term Vision



I'm specifically looking for someone who wants to build a **long-term relationship**.



This starts as a Video Editor position.



But for the right person, there is a real potential progression:



**Video Editor ? Senior Editor ? Content Strategist ? Head of Content / Creative Director**



I would love to eventually find someone capable of becoming much more than an editor.



Someone who understands the brand so deeply that they can help:



* Develop content concepts

* Analyze content and conversion performance

* Plan videos

* Identify winning topics

* Create storytelling frameworks

* Coordinate the content production process

* Direct other editors

* Work alongside videographers

* Shape the visual identity of the brand

* Identify gaps in our personal B-roll/content library

* Help determine what we should create next



As the brand grows, **your compensation and responsibility can grow with it.**



Although this position begins remotely, exceptional long-term team members may eventually have opportunities to work together in person — potentially joining shoots, projects, or team trips in places such as **Paris, Marbella, Dubai, and elsewhere.**



I want to build a small group of extremely capable, ambitious people who genuinely enjoy working together and want to build something significant.



---



# How to Apply



Read this carefully.



**Start your application with the word "OMEGA".**



If your application doesn't begin with OMEGA, I'll assume you didn't read the job description.



Then send me ONLY the following:



## 1. Your 3 Best Short-Form Edits



Send the **three best Reels/Shorts you've ever edited.**



Not 30.



Your three best.



## 2. Your Best Long-Form YouTube Edit



Send the **single best long-form YouTube video you've edited.**



## 3. Your Rate & Availability



Tell me:



* Your preferred hourly rate

* Your preferred monthly rate

* Approximately how many hours per week you can dedicate



## 4. Your Creative Taste



Name **three creators whose content/editing you admire** and briefly explain why.



## 5. Your Experience With This World



Tell me what business, entrepreneurship, psychology, performance, or personal-development content you personally consume.



I genuinely want to know.



## 6. Your Contribution



For every portfolio example, tell me what YOU personally did:



* Editing

* Clip selection

* Personal B-roll selection

* Motion graphics

* Captions

* Sound design

* Hook creation

* Storytelling

* Thumbnail/design



Don't claim an entire team's work as your own.



## 7. One Thing You Would Improve



After looking at my YouTube and Instagram, tell me **one thing you would immediately improve about my current content or editing.**



Don't tell me what you think I want to hear.



I want to understand **how you think creatively.**



---



# Selection Process



If I like your portfolio, I'll send you footage from one of my videos.



Before you even edit it, I may ask you to:



1. Find the three strongest potential Reels

2. Give me their timestamps

3. Create a potential hook/title for each

4. Explain WHY you selected them



This tests something I care deeply about:



**How you think.**



Final candidates may then receive a **paid editing test**.



You'll be evaluated on both technical execution and creative judgment.



---



# Compensation



I'm initially looking around the **$5–$7/hour range**, depending on skill, experience, speed, and portfolio.



I'm also open to fixed monthly arrangements.



If your rate is slightly outside this range but you believe you're exceptional, **apply anyway.**



If you become extremely valuable to the brand, I'm happy for your compensation to reflect that.



I'm not looking for the cheapest editor.



**I'm looking for someone currently undervalued who has the ambition to become world-class.**



If you're hungry, extremely ambitious, obsessed with improving your craft, and excited by the idea of helping build a brand from the ground up into something significant, I want to hear from you.



If you read this and thought:



**"This sounds exactly like me."**



Start your application with:



**OMEGA**

While Laravel and UnoPim experience is still valuable, the main focus of this role is now on Shopify, Klaviyo and server-side tracking. Laravel development may be supported internally where required.

title: Upwork Job Applicant
description:
Upwork Job Application & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant



Remote | Part-Time / Full-Time | OnlineJobs.ph



About the Role



I'm looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help manage job searching, opportunity research, and application submissions through Upwork.



This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable navigating Upwork, reviewing job descriptions, identifying strong opportunities, and submitting high-quality applications based on specific instructions.



The goal is to help streamline the application process and identify opportunities for clients looking for roles in areas such as:



Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Business Development Representative (BDR)

Lead Generation

Appointment Setting

Cold Calling

Sales Outreach

CRM Management

Other sales and business development roles

This is not just a "click and apply" position. You'll need to understand what makes an opportunity relevant, follow application instructions carefully, and help prioritize the best opportunities.



What You'll Be Doing



Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:



Searching Upwork for relevant job opportunities.

Reviewing job descriptions and requirements.

Identifying roles that match specific client experience and skill sets.

Applying to approved jobs on behalf of clients.

Writing or customizing application responses based on templates and instructions.

Tracking submitted applications.

Organizing job opportunities in a spreadsheet or tracking system.

Keeping track of responses, interviews, and follow-ups.

Identifying companies that may need help with SDR work, lead generation, appointment setting, or outbound sales.

Researching smaller companies that may not have established recruiting or sales systems.

Identifying opportunities where companies need help building or improving their prospecting process.

Helping organize application workflows so opportunities can be reviewed and submitted efficiently.

Understanding the Opportunity



Many of the companies posting on Upwork are smaller businesses or early-stage companies.



Some may not have a fully developed sales process. They may be looking for someone to:



Generate leads.

Build prospect lists.

Set up basic prospecting systems.

Conduct outbound outreach.

Book meetings.

Make cold calls.

Manage CRM activity.

Help build their sales development process from the ground up.

Your job will be to help identify these opportunities and determine which ones are worth applying to.



Some companies may have very clear job descriptions, while others may simply know that they need help generating leads or growing their business. Being able to understand what the company is actually looking for is important.



Upwork Experience Is Strongly Preferred



Because Upwork operates differently from traditional job boards, previous experience using the platform is strongly preferred.



You should understand:



How to search for relevant opportunities.

How to review job postings.

How to identify legitimate and worthwhile opportunities.

How the application process works.

How to track submitted proposals.

How to follow instructions carefully.

How to avoid duplicate applications.

How to manage application volume without sacrificing quality.

Some applications may require Connects, which are used to submit proposals on Upwork. Because of this, it's important that applications are submitted strategically and not wasted on poor-fit opportunities.



Additional Responsibilities



As the role grows, you may also help with:



Finding potential clients who need lead generation support.

Researching companies that are hiring SDRs, BDRs, appointment setters, or sales professionals.

Identifying businesses that may need help setting up outbound systems.

Tracking hiring trends and job opportunities.

Organizing client information.

Managing application pipelines.

Following up on submitted applications.

Assisting with onboarding and organizing new clients.

There may also be opportunities to help with other platforms and job boards in the future.



What I'm Looking For



I'm looking for someone who is:



Extremely detail-oriented.

Reliable and consistent.

Comfortable working independently.

Familiar with Upwork.

Good at reading and understanding job descriptions.

Able to follow specific instructions.

Organized and comfortable tracking multiple applications.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and online tools.

Strong in written English.

Able to move quickly without becoming careless.

Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear.

Experience in any of the following is a major plus:



Upwork job applications

Lead generation

SDR or BDR work

Appointment setting

Recruiting

Sales prospecting

LinkedIn job searching

CRM management

Cold
 or outreach

Training and Process



You will not be expected to figure everything out on your own.



I will provide guidance on:



The types of jobs we are targeting.

Which opportunities should be prioritized.

What types of roles should be avoided.

How applications should be written.

What information should be included in proposals.

How to track applications.

How to identify a good-fit opportunity.

How to organize the overall workflow.

The goal is to create a repeatable system where we can efficiently find and apply to strong opportunities without sacrificing quality.



Important: This Role May Grow



This position will likely evolve over time.



As we build out the process, additional responsibilities, tools, and workflows may be introduced. I'm looking for someone who is comfortable adapting and learning as the business grows.



There may also be opportunities to take on additional clients and responsibilities depending on performance and workload.



To Apply



Please send me the following:



A short introduction about yourself.

Your previous experience using Upwork.

Examples of the types of jobs or clients you have helped apply for.

Your experience with lead generation, sales, recruiting, or job searching.

The tools and platforms you are comfortable using.

Your availability and preferred working hours.

Your expected hourly rate.

Bonus Question:



If you were given a client with SDR and BDR experience, what would you look for in an Upwork job posting before d
 whether it was worth applying to?



Please answer this question in your application. I'm looking for someone who can think critically about opportunities, not just submit applications blindly.

title: YouTube Video Editor – True Crime / IRL Documentary (Project-Based)
description:
I’m an actor, stand-up comedian, host, and content creator launching a new YouTube series called LaVelle LaRue LIVE.



The channel focuses on real-world investigations of notorious murders, disappearances, celebrity cases, organized crime stories, historic crime scenes, unsolved mysteries, and bizarre locations around Southern California.



The style I’m building is similar to fast-paced IRL documentary/investigation channels such as Tyler Oliveira, but with my own personality, acting, comedy, storytelling, and true-crime focus.



I am looking for a talented editor who understands YouTube retention and storytelling, not someone who simply cuts footage together.



This will start as project-based freelance work because the channel is new. If we work well together and the channel grows as planned, my goal is to turn this into consistent weekly work and eventually a full-time editing position.



What You’ll Edit



Typical videos will be approximately 10–25 minutes long and may include:



IRL investigation footage

interviews

livestream footage

voiceover

archival photos and video

news footage where legally usable

maps and location graphics

screenshots/documents

music and sound design

comedic moments

suspenseful storytelling

text and captions

B-roll

transitions between locations

occasional simple motion graphics



The finished video should feel like the viewer is inside the investigation with me, not watching a slow traditional documentary.



Editing Style I Need



You must understand how to create:



a strong first 30 seconds

fast pacing without making the video exhausting

visual changes that maintain attention

curiosity gaps

tension and escalation

story progression

clean interview edits

emotional/comedic reaction timing

B-roll placement

maps and location graphics

archive/photo sequences

music changes that support the story

sound effects when appropriate

clean color and audio

professional YouTube storytelling



Every 30–90 seconds should ideally introduce something new: a clue, location, person, fact, question, image, conflict, theory, or discovery.



Reference Style



Before applying, please watch this video so you understand the pacing and storytelling style I am looking for:



“I Investigated the Country Where Every Drug is Legal...” by Tyler Oliveira



You do NOT need to copy his graphics or personality. I want the pacing, field-documentary energy, storytelling, visual variety, and forward movement adapted to my true-crime investigation series.



Who I’m Looking For



You should:



have experience editing YouTube long-form content

understand audience retention

understand documentary/story editing

know how to find and organize B-roll

be comfortable working with a lot of raw footage

understand music and sound design

have strong English comprehension

communicate reliably

meet deadlines

accept feedback and revisions

care about storytelling



Premiere Pro is preferred. After Effects knowledge is a major plus.



Experience editing true crime, documentaries, IRL videos, journalism, travel videos, or investigative content is strongly preferred.



Starting Compensation



This position will begin per project, not as a full-time salary.



Initial range:



$100–$150 USD per completed long-form video, depending on length, complexity, experience, and quality.



Additional Shorts/Reels may be paid separately.



Rates can increase as the channel grows and as we develop a long-term working relationship.



There is strong potential for regular weekly work and eventually a full-time position for the right editor.



How To Apply



Please send:



Your name

Your location/time zone

Your editing software

2–5 examples of your BEST YouTube edits

Any documentary, true-crime, IRL, interview, or storytelling edits you have completed

How long you normally need to edit a 15-minute YouTube video

Your rate per finished 10–20 minute video

Your internet speed

Your computer specifications

Tell me what you think makes the Tyler Oliveira reference video hold attention



At the end of your application, write:



“LAVELLE LIVE”



so I know you actually read the entire job post.



Shortlisted editors may be offered a paid test edit before receiving a full project.



WAGE / SALARY



Enter:



$100–$150 per long-form video / Project Based



If the site forces you to use an hourly or monthly-looking format, put:



$5–$8/hour equivalent – Project Based



But in the description, keep the per-project rate as the real compensation structure.



I prefer per-project at this stage because it protects your cash flow and rewards editors who work efficiently.



I would not offer unpaid test edits.



For finalists, give them the same 2–3 minute section of raw footage and pay approximately:



$25–$40 for the test edit.



You'll learn much more from that than from portfolios.



DESIRED NUMBER OF HOURS PER WEEK



Put:



10



You're not promising ten hours every single week. You're communicating the approximate workload you're starting with.



Once you're producing heavily, we'll increase this substantially.



BUSINESS OR CONTACT NAME



Put:



LaVelle LaRue LIVE / Laugh Nation



That makes it look like they're joining a real media operation rather than doing random freelance work for an individual.



SKILLS REQUIREMENT



Search for and add the closest available choices to these, up to the site's maximum:



Video Editing

Adobe Premiere Pro

Adobe After Effects

YouTube

Motion Graphics

Audio Editing

Graphic Design

Social Media Video Editing

Storytelling

YouTube Video Editing



If "Storytelling" isn't available, replace it with something like Content Creation.



The three I care about most are:



Video Editing + Premiere Pro + YouTube



After Effects is valuable, but I would take an elite storyteller with basic graphics over an After Effects wizard who can't hold retention.



NOTIFICATION



Send all applicants to my
 address: 



At the beginning I want you to see everybody.



Once you start getting flooded, we can tighten the filtering process.

title: 3D Footwear Modeler using Blender
description:
About the Role



I run an independent design studio specializing in footwear, product design, 3D modeling, and visualization. I'm looking for a talented 3D footwear modeler who works primarily in Blender to help execute client projects for the studio.



You will work from my creative direction, sketches, reference images, existing concepts, and feedback to develop high-quality 3D footwear models.



This is primarily an execution role. I will generally establish the design direction, and I need someone who can take that direction and accurately translate it into polished 3D footwear.



This will be part-time as projects will come in at different times.



Responsibilities

- Model footwear concepts in Blender from sketches, references, and creative direction

- Build clean, detailed shoe geometry including uppers, soles, panels, seams, padding, and other components

- Refine proportions, surfaces, transitions, and construction details

- Make revisions based on clear feedback and art direction

- Prepare organized Blender files for continued development

- Maintain clean topology and organized scene/file structure

- Work across different footwear styles and design languages

- Communicate progress clearly and meet agreed deadlines



Required:



- Strong Blender modeling skills (CAD or Nurbs modeling not needed)

- Experience modeling footwear or similarly complex consumer products

- Strong understanding of form, proportion, and surface quality

- Ability to accurately model from 2D references

- Comfortable receiving detailed feedback and making revisions

- Organized and reliable

- Strong attention to detail



Nice to Have:



- Professional footwear design experience

- Understanding of footwear construction

- Experience with 3D-printable footwear

- Sculpting experience in Blender

- Retopology and mesh cleanup experience



To apply please include:



- A link to your portfolio

title: Medical Biller and Cover
description:
Medical Biller and Coder



Interview Process:

Candidates selected to move forward will complete a written exercise, followed by two rounds of interviews.



About Clarity Works



Clarity Works helps medical practices recover revenue, reduce billing delays, work denials, and improve revenue cycle performance. We are looking for an experienced Medical Biller and Coder who can manage complex billing workflows, own client work, and help create cleaner, repeatable processes.



Role Overview



This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for someone with at least 7 years of medical billing and coding experience, preferably in a senior, lead, or supervisory role.



The right candidate is a self-starter who can work in a fast-paced environment with minimal direction. This person must be able to create claims from scratch, not just work existing claims. They should be comfortable owning assigned clients, identifying problems, working through billing issues, and documenting processes clearly.



Responsibilities



* Create, review, correct, and submit medical claims

* Build claims from scratch using documentation, codes, payer rules, and billing requirements

* Work denials, rejections, underpayments, and aged A/R

* Review documentation and assign or validate appropriate codes

* Identify billing, coding, payer, and workflow issues

* Follow up with payers on claim status, denials, and payment issues

* Review EOBs, ERAs, and payer correspondence

* Support payment posting and account reconciliation when needed

* Own assigned client workflows and communicate updates, blockers, and next steps

* Problem-solve issues independently before escalating

* Create SOPs for new systems, workflows, and client-specific processes

* Work across different EHR, PM, clearinghouse, and payer portal systems

* Help improve internal billing processes as the company grows



Requirements



* Minimum 7 years of medical billing and coding experience

* Prior experience in a senior, lead, or high-responsibility billing role preferred

* Strong denial management and A/R follow-up experience

* Ability to create claims from scratch, not just correct or resubmit existing claims

* Experience working in multiple EHR, PM, clearinghouse, and payer portal systems

* Strong understanding of claim submission, coding, payer rules, EOBs, ERAs, and reimbursement workflows

* Ability to work independently with minimal direction

* Comfortable owning client work and taking initiative

* Able to work in a fast-paced environment

* Proactive, organized, and solutions-oriented

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Comfortable creating SOPs and documenting processes

* Detail-oriented, reliable, and accountable



Preferred Experience



* Certified coder preferred, but not required with strong experience

* Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers

* Experience supporting multiple specialties

* Experience working in a billing company, RCM company, or multi-client environment

* Experience training or supporting other billers



Schedule



Part-time  in the beginning with move to full time eventually



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for a seasoned biller and coder who can take ownership, move quickly, problem-solve, and manage client work without constant oversight. This role is best for someone who has already handled complex billing environments and does not need beginner-level training.

title: CRM Follow-Up Specialist - Mortgage Pipeline (Part-Time, US Hours)
description:
We are a US mortgage lender looking for a part-time CRM Follow-Up Specialist to take ownership of our client pipeline.



We are good at getting people interested. We are not good enough at following up with them consistently, and leads are falling through the cracks as a result. That is the problem you are here to solve.



This is a long-term role with real ownership. The person who does this well will be offered full-time hours and a raise.





WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



You will own our CRM (GoHighLevel) and make sure nobody in our database gets forgotten.



Every day:



- Work the call queue: follow up by phone with people who inquired about a mortgage and have not been reached yet

- Follow up with people who started an application but have not finished it

- Follow up with people who said they would apply but have not yet

- Book appointments with our loan officers, or send people the application link

- Move every contact to the correct pipeline stage so our database reflects reality

- Log every single call, text, and
 in the CRM

- Send a short end-of-day report with your numbers



Each week, on a set schedule:



- Monday: check in with our partner real estate agents and ask what they need

- Wednesday: review our past client list and reach out to set up loan review appointments

- Thursday: check in with our pre-approved clients who are actively house hunting

- Friday: clean up stale records and send your weekly report



Your first 6 to 8 weeks will be a cleanup project. We have several hundred records that need to be sorted, contacted, and organized properly. After that, the role becomes maintaining the system you built.





THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS JOB



Consistency. Not brilliance.



Most people give up after one or two attempts. We want someone who follows the process every single time, logs everything, and never lets a record sit untouched. Our number one measure of success is simple: no contact in an active stage goes more than 14 days without a touch.



If that sounds boring to you, this is not your role. If that sounds satisfying, keep reading.





IMPORTANT: WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT INVOLVE



You will NEVER discuss interest rates, loan terms, monthly payments, how much someone qualifies for, or give any kind of financial or mortgage advice. Not by phone, not by text, not by
.



Your job is to reach people, answer basic questions, and connect them with our licensed loan officers. We will train you on exactly what to say and exactly what to hand off. This boundary is not flexible and it is the most important rule of the job.



You will also be handling confidential client information. We take this extremely seriously, you will sign a confidentiality agreement, and you will be given access only to the specific information you need.



HOURS



20 hours per week. 4 hours per day, Monday through Friday.

9:00 AM to 1:00 PM US Eastern Time

(9:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine Time)



This is an evening shift in the Philippines, not a graveyard shift. You keep your days.



We need the hours put in every weekday. Follow-up only works when it happens on schedule, so consistency matters more than total hours. Please only apply if you can commit to this long-term.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required:



- Clear, warm spoken English with a neutral accent. You will be on the phone with American homebuyers every day. This is the single most important requirement.

- At least 1 year of phone-based customer service, follow-up, or appointment setting experience

- Genuinely organized and detail-obsessed. You will manage hundreds of records and none of them can be forgotten.

- Comfortable making calls to people who did not answer the first time, and doing it without sounding pushy or discouraged

- Reliable computer, headset, and stable internet

- Trustworthy with confidential information



Nice to have, not required:



- Experience with GoHighLevel or a similar CRM

- Experience in US mortgage, real estate, insurance, or financial services

- Experience cleaning up or reorganizing a messy database





WHAT WE OFFER



- $600 to $700 per month for 20 hours per week, depending on experience

- Clear path to full-time hours and a raise based on performance

- Performance review at 3 months, including a bonus structure once we have established your baseline numbers

- A company
 address and full ownership of this system

- Complete training with recorded video walkthroughs. We will not drop you in with no support.





HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these steps exactly. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed, because attention to detail is most of this job.



1. Start your application with the word ANCHOR so we know you read this.



2. Record a 60-second voice message (Vocaroo, Google Drive, or any link).



Pretend you are calling someone who asked us about a mortgage two weeks ago and has not returned any of our calls. Leave them a voi
.



 Just talk. Do not read a script. We want to hear how you actually sound on the phone.



3. In 3 to 4 sentences: tell us about a time you were responsible for keeping a database, CRM, or list organized. How did you make sure nothing got missed?



4. Tell us your internet speed and confirm you can work 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine Time, Monday through Friday.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short test task before the final video interview.



We read every application that follows the instructions. Thank you for your time, and good luck.

Responsibilities

Research profitable Amazon products using Keepa and SellerAmp SAS

Evaluate seasonality

Find legitimate U.S. wholesalers and distributors

Enter researched opportunities into our provided spreadsheet

Stable Buy Box

NO IP/complaint risk

Products available from legitimate wholesalers/distributors

Amazon FBA

Amazon wholesale sourcing

Keepa

SellerAmp SAS

Reverse sourcing

Buy Box analysis

ROI and profit calculations

Wholesale/distributor research

How to Apply

How many years/months have you sourced products for Amazon sellers?

This could be a great long-term position for someone who enjoys variety and is interested in **fragrance, content creation, social media, research, technology, and creative projects.**



## Main Responsibilities



### 1. YouTube & TikTok Content Research



Help me research and prepare upcoming episodes and social media content.



Tasks may include:



* Research topics for upcoming YouTube videos and TikTok content

* Research fragrances, brands, products, trends, and competitors

* Gather facts, prices, fragrance notes, release information, and other useful details

* Help organize research into episode notes and outlines

* Find interesting angles or information that could make an episode stronger

* Maintain lists of future episodes and content ideas

* Help organize a content calendar

* Organize research sources and links so information can be easily verified



You will primarily be responsible for **research and organization rather than writing in my voice.**



### 2. Video Editing & Short-Form Content



Help turn my raw video footage into finished and short-form content.



Tasks may include:



* Basic editing of YouTube videos

* Remove mistakes, long pauses, repeated sections, and unusable footage

* Create clean cuts and basic transitions

* Identify strong moments from longer videos

* Turn long-form YouTube content into TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Add captions and basic on-screen text

* Resize and format content for different platforms

* Organize raw and edited video files



You should already have experience with at least one video-editing platform such as **CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere, or similar software.**



I am not looking for advanced cinematic editing. I am looking for someone who can create **clean, engaging, social-media-ready edits.**



### 3. Fragrance Collection & Spreadsheet Management



I have a large and growing personal fragrance collection that I want to keep accurately documented.



Tasks may include:



* Maintain and update my perfume collection spreadsheet

* Add new fragrances as they are purchased

* Research fragrance houses and brands

* Research fragrance notes

* Research perfumers

* Research release dates

* Research sizes and concentrations

* Research scent families

* Research pricing and other product information

* Categorize fragrances

* Identify missing or incomplete information

* Keep the database clean and consistent



An interest in **perfume, fragrance, beauty, body care, or cosmetics is a major plus**, but fragrance expertise is not required.



I am willing to teach the right person about fragrance.



### 4. App Research & Raw Data Collection



I am developing a fragrance-related application and need assistance researching, collecting, cleaning, and organizing raw data.



Tasks may include:



* Research perfumes and fragrance products

* Collect publicly available fragrance information

* Enter information into structured spreadsheets

* Research fragrance notes and scent families

* Research fragrance brands and product lines

* Clean and standardize data

* Identify duplicates

* Identify missing information

* Follow specific data-entry and formatting rules

* Organize datasets so they can eventually be used within the application



**Accuracy is extremely important for this part of the job.**



You should be willing to verify information using reliable sources rather than simply copying the first search result or accepting AI-generated information as fact.



### 5. Canva & T-Shirt Design Support



**Strong Canva skills are required for this position.**



I am developing t-shirt and merchandise concepts and need someone who can take an approved creative direction and help turn it into a finished design.



I will often develop or approve the initial concept. Your role will be to help **execute and refine the design.**



Tasks may include:



* Create t-shirt designs in Canva based on approved concepts

* Work with typography, graphics, spacing, and layouts

* Create multiple design variations when requested

* Make revisions based on feedback

* Create t-shirt mockups for review

* Prepare designs in appropriate sizes and dimensions

* Prepare final files for printing or print-on-demand use

* Keep Canva projects, templates, graphics, and design assets organized

* Create or modify YouTube thumbnails

* Create social media graphics

* Resize designs for different platforms or products

* Assist with other simple branding and promotional materials



You do **not** need to originate every design concept from scratch.



I am looking for someone who can take a clear idea or creative direction and turn it into a polished Canva design.



### 6. General Administrative & Project Support



Occasional tasks may include:



* Google Sheets and spreadsheet maintenance

* Internet research

* Data entry

* Organizing Google Drive files and folders

* Updating project trackers

* Maintaining task lists

* Organizing research

* Creating simple documents

* Organizing content files

* Other small administrative tasks as needed



## Required Skills



You should already be comfortable with:



* **Canva**

* **Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel**

* **Google Docs**

* **Google Drive**

* **Basic video editing**

* **Internet research**

* **Data entry**

* **YouTube, TikTok, and/or Instagram**

* **ChatGPT or similar AI tools**



You do not need to know every tool I use on your first day, but you should be comfortable learning new software and following written instructions.



## Who I'm Looking For



I am looking for someone who is:



* Reliable and consistent

* Extremely organized

* Detail-oriented

* A strong internet researcher

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at following detailed written instructions

* Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

* Comfortable working with spreadsheets

* Comfortable performing repetitive data tasks when necessary

* Creative and visually minded

* Comfortable with Canva

* Comfortable editing video

* Interested in learning about fragrance

* Able to verify AI-generated information rather than assuming it is correct

Perfect spoken English is **not required** because most of this position will be behind the scenes.



## Hours & Compensation



**Starting Rate: $2.00 USD/hour   Maximum Rate: $4.00**



**Maximum: 7 hours per week initially, with potential to expand to 25 hours a week in 2027**



This is intended to become an ongoing working relationship rather than a one-time project.



Because the position is limited to five hours per week, I will prioritize assignments each week.



I am looking for someone who can **complete meaningful work efficiently**, not someone who simply stays logged in for five hours.



There may be opportunities for additional hours and responsibilities in the future if we work well together.



## How to Apply

### IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



At the **very beginning of your application**, write the name of your favorite perfume, fragrance note, beauty product, or scent.

**Vanilla**

title: Outbound Appointment Setter - Real Estate Partnerships (Part-Time, US Hours)
description:
We are a US-based real estate education and marketing company looking for a part-time Outbound Appointment Setter to help grow our partner network.



This is a long-term role. We are building this position out, and the person who performs will be offered full-time hours with a raise. That is a real path, not a maybe.





WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



Your job is simple to describe and hard to do well: start conversations with real estate agents and community partners in the United States and book them into a 15-minute intro call with our founder.



Day to day:



- Pull and filter target lists from our CRM (we will train you on this)

- Find each agent on social media and verify the account

- Send personalized social media direct messages from our founder's account

- Send follow-up
s using our proven sequences

- Manage the inbox: respond to replies, answer basic questions, handle common objections

- Book qualified appointments directly into our booking calendar

- Confirm appointments and send reminders so people actually show up

- Log every touch and outcome in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

- Send a short end-of-day report with your numbers



You will NOT be cold calling strangers and you will NOT be figuring this out on your own. We give you the target list, the scripts, the
 sequences, the CRM, and a full library of recorded training videos. Your job is to execute the system consistently and personalize every message so it does not read like a template.



IMPORTANT: This role never involves discussing loans, interest rates, loan terms, or giving any kind of financial advice. You set appointments. That is the whole job. We will train you on exactly what to say if someone asks a question you cannot answer.





HOURS



20 hours per week. 4 hours per day, Monday through Friday.

8:00 AM to 12:00 PM US Eastern Time

(8:00 PM to 12:00 AM Philippine Time)



This is an evening shift in the Philippines, not a graveyard shift. You keep your days.



We need the hours put in every weekday, not 20 hours whenever. Outreach only works when follow-up is consistent, so daily rhythm matters more than total hours. Please only apply if you can commit to this schedule long-term.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required:



- Excellent written English. Natural and conversational, not stiff or formal.

- Clear spoken English with a neutral accent (some calls involved)

- At least 1 year of outbound appointment setting, sales development, or cold outreach experience

- Reliable computer and stable internet

- Comfortable being measured on a number every single day

- Genuinely organized. You will be managing hundreds of ongoing conversations at once.



Nice to have, not required:



- Experience with GoHighLevel or a similar CRM

- Experience in US real estate, mortgage, or insurance

- Familiarity with Social Media DM outreach at volume





WHAT WE OFFER



- $500 to $700 per month for 20 hours per week, depending on experience

- Clear path to full-time hours and a raise based on performance

- Performance review at 3 months, including a bonus structure once we have established your baseline numbers

- A company
 address and real ownership of your territory

- Full training. We will not drop you in with no support.





HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these steps exactly. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed, because attention to detail is most of this job.



1. Start your application with the word ORANGE so we know you read this.



2. In 3 to 4 sentences, tell us about a time you booked appointments with a cold audience. What was your process, and what were your actual numbers?



3. Record a 60-second voice message (Vocaroo, Google Drive, or any link) answering this question:



   "Why would a busy real estate agent want to take a call with you?"



   Just talk. Do not read a script. We want to hear how you actually sound.



4. Tell us your internet speed and confirm you can work 8:00 PM to 12:00 AM Philippine Time, Monday through Friday.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short test task before the final video interview.



We read every application that follows the instructions. Thank you for your time, and good luck.

title: Controller
description:
Controller



Position Type: TBD

Work Arrangement: Remote

Industry: Medical Equipment / Distribution

Reports To: Executive Leadership



Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced Controller to lead and oversee the company’s accounting and financial operations. This role requires a hands-on finance leader who can manage the full accounting cycle while providing management with clear visibility into cash flow, profitability, margins, inventory, and overall financial performance.



The ideal candidate will have strong experience in distribution or wholesale, particularly with inventory accounting, COGS management, equipment sales, and margin analysis. Experience working with a U.S.-based company and understanding U.S. GAAP is required.



Because the company has recently undergone an acquisition, the Controller will also play an important role in post-acquisition financial integration, including improving reporting processes, supporting system integration, and developing reliable financial reporting for the new ownership structure.



Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Financial Operations

Manage the company’s full-cycle accounting operations, including:

General Ledger

Accounts Payable

Accounts Receivable

Payroll

Bank and account reconciliations

Month-end and year-end close

Maintain accurate and timely financial records in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

Prepare and review financial statements, including the Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Statement, Cash Flow Statement, and supporting schedules.

Establish and maintain strong internal controls and accounting procedures.

Coordinate with external CPAs, auditors, tax professionals, and other financial partners.

Ensure accounting deadlines, reporting requirements, and compliance obligations are consistently met.

Cash Flow & Financial Management

Own the company’s cash flow management and forecasting process.

Develop short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts.

Monitor incoming customer payments and outgoing vendor, payroll, tax, and operating obligations.

Identify potential cash flow issues and proactively communicate them to leadership.

Provide recommendations to improve working capital and cash availability.

Analyze financial performance and provide management with actionable recommendations.

Inventory, COGS & Distribution Accounting

Oversee accounting for inventory, including inventory costing, valuation, cycle counts, adjustments, and shrinkage.

Monitor and analyze Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and gross margins.

Review equipment sales margins and identify profitability trends.

Analyze inventory purchases, vendor costs, freight, and other costs affecting product margins.

Work with operations and sales teams to ensure inventory and project costs are accurately captured.

Develop reporting that provides visibility into profitability by product, customer, project, or business segment.

Post-Acquisition Integration

Support the financial integration of the company following the recent acquisition.

Assist with the integration of accounting processes, systems, financial records, and reporting requirements.

Help establish consistent accounting policies and procedures under the new ownership structure.

Support potential ERP or accounting-system migration and implementation.

Develop and maintain accurate reporting for ownership and executive leadership.

Prepare or support monthly management and board-level financial reporting packages.

Establish KPIs and dashboards that provide ownership with clear visibility into financial performance.

Ensure financial data from multiple entities or business units can be consolidated accurately when required.

Financial Analysis & Strategic Support

Provide leadership with financial analysis to support business decisions.

Analyze revenue, expenses, gross margins, operating costs, working capital, and profitability.

Develop budgets, forecasts, and financial models.

Identify cost-saving opportunities and areas for improving profitability.

Evaluate the financial impact of major purchases, vendor agreements, projects, and business initiatives.

Partner with leadership to establish financial targets and monitor performance against them.

Industry & Compliance Responsibilities

Apply accounting knowledge relevant to medical equipment and distribution businesses.

Understand the financial impact of OEM/vendor relationships, rebates, discounts, and partner agreements.

Understand the accounting differences between capital equipment and consumable products.

Maintain awareness of applicable sales-tax considerations related to medical equipment.

Support compliance requirements applicable to the company’s healthcare-adjacent business relationships.

Maintain appropriate documentation for financial transactions and vendor/customer relationships.

Qualifications

Required Experience

5–8+ years of accounting or finance experience.

2–3+ years of experience in a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager role.

Strong background in distribution, wholesale, or equipment-based businesses.

Demonstrated experience managing full-cycle accounting.

Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP.

Experience with inventory accounting, COGS, and gross-margin analysis.

Experience with cash flow forecasting and financial planning.

Experience preparing and analyzing financial statements.

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and financial modeling capabilities.

Experience with accounting/ERP systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage, or similar platforms.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Preferred Experience

Medical device, medical equipment, healthcare, or healthcare-adjacent industry experience.

Experience with post-acquisition integration.

Experience working under a private equity, holding company, or investor-owned structure.

Experience with multi-entity accounting and consolidation.

Experience implementing or migrating ERP/accounting systems.

Experience preparing investor, board, or PE-style reporting packages.

Familiarity with vendor rebates and OEM partner agreements.

Experience analyzing profitability for capital equipment sales.

Remote Work Requirements

Previous experience working remotely with a U.S.-based team.

Ability to maintain meaningful working-hour overlap with the U.S. Eastern Time Zone.

Strong communication skills when working with executives, vendors, customers, OEM partners, and internal teams.

Highly organized, self-directed, and capable of managing deadlines independently.

Comfortable working with cloud-based accounting, communication, and business systems.

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is more than a bookkeeper or financial reporting specialist. We are looking for a hands-on Controller who can understand the entire financial picture of the business and help leadership make better decisions.



This person should be able to clearly answer:



How much cash do we have available?

What cash is expected to come in and when?

What payments and obligations are coming due?

Which products, projects, and customers are most profitable?

Where are margins being lost?

How much capital is tied up in inventory?

What is driving changes in COGS and gross margin?

How is the business performing against budget and forecast?

What financial risks should leadership be aware of?

What actions can the company take to improve cash flow and profitability?

Key Success Measures



Success in this role will be measured by:



Accurate and timely monthly financial close.

Reliable financial statements and management reporting.

Improved cash flow visibility and forecasting accuracy.

Strong inventory and COGS controls.

Accurate gross-margin and profitability reporting.

Timely identification of financial risks and opportunities.

Successful integration of accounting processes following the acquisition.

Effective reporting to executive leadership and new ownership.

Improved financial controls, processes, and operational efficiency.

We also want structured systems so sermons, events, announcements, and other content can be updated efficiently rather than manually rebuilding pages.



You should be comfortable working with WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms and be able to recommend the best solution rather than simply using whatever tool you already know.



2. Weekly Worship Service ? Automated Content Engine



Our worship services and sermons are published to YouTube.



We want to create an automated workflow that takes each new worship service and turns it into useful digital content.



The system should be capable of:



Detecting a newly published YouTube worship service.

Obtaining or creating a transcript.

Identifying the sermon and important moments.

Generating a sermon summary.

Identifying strong quotations.

Identifying potential short-form video clips.

Creating vertical clips for
, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Adding captions/subtitles.

Extracting useful still images when appropriate.

Creating quote graphics using church-branded Canva templates.

Writing draft social-media captions.

Creating several posts from each Sunday service.

Placing proposed content into an approval queue.

Publishing approved content according to a content calendar.

Saving finished content in an organized archive.



The objective is simple:



One Sunday worship service should automatically become a week of useful digital ministry content.



We want AI to do most of the repetitive work while a human retains final approval.



3. Social Media Automation



Build and document a repeatable social-media system for our church.



Content will primarily come from:



Weekly sermons

Worship services

Scripture

Church events

Seasonal church activities

Ministry announcements

Bible studies

Preschool activities where appropriate



The system may use tools such as:



ChatGPT / OpenAI

Claude

Canva

Descript

CapCut

OpusClip

Buffer

Metricool

Meta Business Suite

YouTube

Google Drive



I am open to better recommendations.



The objective is NOT to create generic AI-generated religious content.



Content should primarily originate from our actual pastors, worship services, congregation, ministries, and events.



4. AI Telephone Agent



Help us implement an AI voice agent that can answer the church telephone during and after office hours.



The agent should eventually be able to answer common questions such as:



What time is worship?

Where are you located?

How do I contact the pastor?

How do I contact the preschool?

When is Bible study?

Is there an event happening this week?

How do I speak with someone about baptism, weddings, funerals, membership, etc.?



The agent should be able to:



Answer approved FAQs

Retrieve information from an approved church knowledge base

Transfer callers to appropriate people/extensions

Take messages

Collect name, telephone number, and reason for calling

Send appropriate notifications

Recognize when it does NOT know an answer

Escalate sensitive or pastoral matters to a human



Possible tools include Twilio, Vapi, Retell AI, Bland AI, OpenAI voice tools, or other appropriate systems.



You should be able to research options and recommend the best combination based on reliability, cost, and maintainability.



Central Knowledge Base



A major part of this project is creating a reliable single source of truth for the church.



This may live in Google Drive, Notion, Airtable, a database, or another appropriate platform.



It should contain approved information about:



Worship

Staff

Contact information

Ministries

Bible studies

Events

Preschool

Policies

Frequently asked questions

Website content

Sermons

Communications guidelines



The website, social-media workflows, and telephone agent should use this information wherever practical.



Automation



You should have hands-on experience with at least one serious automation platform such as:



n8n

Make.com

Zapier



Preference will be given to applicants with strong n8n or Make.com experience.



You should understand:



APIs

Webhooks

JSON

HTTP requests

Authentication/API keys

Conditional workflows

Error handling

Retry logic

Logging

Alerts

Data storage

AI/LLM API calls



I do not expect you to know every product listed in this job description.



I DO expect you to be technically curious and capable of researching, testing, learning, and solving problems independently.



Documentation Is Required



Everything you build must be documented.



We do not want systems that only work while you are employed.



For every important automation, you will create:



A simple workflow diagram

Written SOP

List of accounts/tools involved

Description of what triggers the automation

Description of what happens

Error/recovery procedure

Short Loom/video walkthrough when appropriate



Credentials must remain in church-controlled accounts and password-management systems.



Security & Privacy



Because this is a church, some communications may involve personal or sensitive information.



You must understand that AI should NOT independently provide pastoral counseling, emergency advice, financial commitments, theological rulings, or confidential information.



Sensitive matters must be routed to a human.



You must also follow good practices for:

API keys

Permissions

Personal information

Who I Am Looking For

Are comfortable using AI tools

Work Arrangement

I run a YouTube channel making animated documentary-comedy videos in the flat cartoon style of OverSimplified and Agent Flappy — big-headed characters, bold outlines, painterly backgrounds, fast cuts, deadpan humor.



? Style reference — watch this before applying:


 ("World War 2 Explained in 31 Minutes" by Agent Flappy)

This is the target: that art style, that cut pacing (a new scene or gag every few seconds), that humor. Especially study the first 60 seconds. If you can produce work at this level, we should talk.

Edit and deliver a finished video synced to the voiceover, with fast cuts that follow the story beat by beat — matching the reference video's pacing



You're the right person if this sounds like your normal workday: you build characters in Illustrator with every animatable part on its own named layer and arms as bare strokes; you import as compositions into After Effects, convert limbs with Create Shapes from Vector Layer, and animate poses by keyframing the path — never rotating a stiff arm; your emotions are eyebrow and mouth path tweaks; your reactions start on the contact frame.



Requirements:



Portfolio with at least one piece in this specific style — applications without a relevant portfolio link will not be read

Character design ability in this style, not just animation of provided art

Ability to sustain a one video per week delivery schedule

Reliable communication

title: Real Estate Seller Closer / Acquisition & Listing Specialist
description:
REAL ESTATE SELLER CLOSER / ACQUISITION & LISTING SPECIALIST



We are seeking an experienced **Real Estate Seller Closer** to work with warm, qualified U.S. property-owner leads and convert conversations into opportunities and deals.



**THIS IS NOT A COLD-CALLING OR APPOINTMENT-SETTING POSITION.**

### FOLLOW UP BOSS EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED.  **You MUST already know how to use Follow Up Boss.**



Our prospecting and lead-generation team makes the initial contact with property owners. You will work primarily with sellers who have already expressed interest, requested information, spoken with our team, or require continued follow-up.



Your job is to own the seller conversation, uncover the seller's real motivation, discuss price and expectations, handle objections, explain available selling options, negotiate when appropriate, and move the seller toward a clear commitment.



### ABOUT OUR SELLER PROGRAMS:

We operate multiple real estate seller programs, including **Seller Options Now (SON)** and **Realty Offers Now (RON)**.



Unlike companies that offer homeowners only one solution, our business is designed to give sellers multiple ways to sell.



Depending upon the property and seller's objectives, potential solutions may include:

* Direct cash/investor purchase

* Competitive offer or accelerated-sale strategy

* Traditional real estate listing

* Competitive online sale / Offer-to-Sold strategy

* Continued nurture and follow-up when the seller is not ready today



The successful candidate must listen to the seller, understand what they're trying to accomplish, and guide the conversation toward the right solution.



### YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

* Call warm and qualified seller leads

* Follow up consistently with previously contacted property owners

* Build rapport quickly with U.S. homeowners

* Determine seller motivation, timing, property condition, price expectations, and decision-making factors

* Ask strong discovery questions instead of simply reading a script

* Handle pricing objections professionally

* Discuss unrealistic seller expectations without losing rapport

* Negotiate with motivated property sellers

* Explain multiple selling options clearly and confidently

* Maintain control and direction of telephone conversations

* Ask for commitments and establish definite next steps

* Recognize when a seller should move toward a direct purchase, listing, competitive-sale solution, or continued nurture

* Maintain persistent follow-up with sellers who are not ready immediately

* Keep complete and accurate CRM notes after every conversation

* Create and manage follow-up tasks

* Maintain correct stages, tags, and pipeline status

* Communicate important opportunities to management

* Help move qualified seller opportunities from initial interest toward signed agreements and completed transactions



You should have hands-on experience using Follow Up Boss for:

* Contacts

* Notes

* Tasks

* Calling

* Text messaging

*

* Stages

* Tags

* Smart Lists

* Action Plans

* Follow-up

* Pipeline management



Please do not apply if you have never personally used Follow Up Boss.



### EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Strong candidates will have previous experience with one or more of the following:

* Real estate acquisitions

* Motivated seller leads

* U.S. real estate investing

* Acquisition management

* Wholesale real estate

* Residential real estate sales

* Real estate ISA / inside sales

* Listing conversion

* Seller lead management

* High-ticket telephone sales

* Negotiation and objection handling



Experience speaking directly with U.S. property owners is strongly preferred.



You should be comfortable speaking with sellers in situations involving:

* Inherited properties

* Vacant properties

* Landlords

* Properties needing repairs

* Distressed properties

* Relocation

* Financial pressure

* Foreclosure situations

* Sellers considering a Realtor

* Sellers comparing cash offers

* Sellers with unrealistic price expectations

* Sellers who need repeated follow-up before making a decision



### THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT POSITION IF YOU:

* Mainly schedule appointments

* Only have cold-calling experience

* Depend completely on a script

* Are uncomfortable discussing money

* Are afraid to challenge a seller's price expectations

* Give up after receiving an objection

* Do not follow up consistently

* Need someone to tell you every day who to call

* Fail to maintain detailed CRM records

* Have never worked with motivated property sellers



We want someone who understands the difference between **having a conversation and advancing a deal.**



### COMMUNICATION REQUIREMENTS



Excellent spoken and written English is required.



Because you will speak directly with U.S. homeowners, your telephone communication must be professional, natural, confident, conversational, and easy to understand.



We care much more about your ability to communicate, listen, negotiate, and close than we do about having a perfect résumé.



### WORKING HOURS



You must be available during **U.S. Eastern Time business and early-evening seller contact hours**.



The position is expected to begin at approximately **30 hours per week**, with the opportunity to expand based upon performance and lead volume.



### COMPENSATION

Base compensation will depend on experience and demonstrated ability.



Expected range:

**$800–$2,000 USD per month**



Exceptional candidates may qualify for additional **performance-based bonuses and transaction incentives**.



We are looking for a long-term team member. Strong performance can lead to increased responsibility, compensation, and the opportunity to play a larger role in our seller-conversion operation.



### REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS



You must have:

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer
