We are looking for an experienced Shopify professional who knows how to build and grow profitable online retail businesses.



This is not simply a website design or social media posting position. We need someone who understands the complete Shopify ecommerce system, including website development, traffic generation, conversion optimization, social media content, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.



You will work with multiple Shopify-based clients. Some businesses will be starting from scratch, while others will already be operating and need help improving their traffic, conversions, and sales.



Relevant Shopify experience is mandatory. If you cannot provide examples of your work and explain how your efforts generated measurable results, you will not receive a callback.



Responsibilities



• Build professional, mobile-friendly, conversion-focused Shopify websites from scratch



• Audit and improve existing Shopify stores



• Create product pages, collections, navigation, landing pages, and sales funnels



• Improve website conversion rates, average order value, and overall customer experience

• Create and manage ecommerce content for Instagram, TikTok,
, and X

• Connect social media activity to website traffic, leads, and sales



• Set up and improve
 marketing, abandoned-cart campaigns, customer follow-ups, promotions, upsells, cross-sells, and customer-retention systems



• Recommend and implement appropriate Shopify apps, integrations, and automation

• Provide clear reporting on traffic, conversion rates, customer acquisition, sales, and revenue growth



• Manage projects for both new and established online retail businesses



Required Experience



• Proven professional experience building and managing Shopify stores



• Proven experience improving Shopify conversion rates and generating revenue

• Experience creating social media content that drives traffic, engagement, and sales



• Strong experience with Instagram is mandatory



• Experience with TikTok,
, and X is also required



• Understanding of ecommerce funnels, customer journeys, landing pages, product positioning, and promotional offers



• Ability to explain what you changed, why you changed it, and how it affected the client’s results



• Strong written English and communication skills



• Ability to manage multiple client accounts and meet deadlines



• References from previous clients or employers are required



We are looking for someone who thinks beyond making a website look attractive. You must understand how design, content, traffic, offers, product pages, social media,
 marketing, and customer retention work together to generate income.



How to Apply



Use the subject line:



SHOPIFY REVENUE SPECIALIST



Your application must include all of the following:

2. Links to Shopify websites you personally built, managed, or improved

, and X accounts

Applications without Shopify work samples, Instagram examples, measurable results, and references will not be considered.



Please do not apply if your experience is limited to basic website design, uploading products, or creating general social media posts. We need someone with proven ecommerce experience who understands how to turn traffic into customers and Shopify stores into revenue-generating businesses.

title: Proactive Executive & Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:
About the Role



I am looking for a highly organised, proactive and positive Virtual Assistant to support me with the day-to-day administration of my businesses and personal workload.



This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do every step of the way. I need someone who takes initiative, follows up on outstanding items, learns quickly and actively looks for ways to make my day easier.



You will work closely with me across a marketing agency and several other businesses. The tasks will be varied, so you must be comfortable changing priorities, learning new systems and handling both business and occasional personal administration.



Previous experience in marketing, an agency environment or executive assistance would be highly regarded.



Key Responsibilities



Task and project management



Check Monday.com daily and follow up on outstanding tasks

Keep my to-do list organised, prioritised and up to date

Monitor deadlines and remind me of anything requiring my attention

Follow up with employees, contractors, clients and suppliers

Help ensure tasks are completed instead of simply being added to a list

Provide a clear daily update on completed, outstanding and urgent items



Marketing and agency support



Assist with website audits, SEO tasks and Google Business Profile updates

Review files and documents for completeness and accuracy

Assist with client proposals, signage quotes and presentation documents

Coordinate revisions, approvals and outstanding client requirements

Assist with social media, website maintenance and new-client administration

Organise meetings and follow up on action items



Finance and payment administration



Assist with Xero administration and payment tracking

Check invoices, contractor payments and client payments

Monitor Ignition payment arrangements and outstanding accounts

Organise accounting documents and business paperwork

Liaise with our accountant or bookkeeper when required

Maintain accurate records across multiple businesses



General business administration



Prepare and organise contracts, terms and conditions, tenders and paperwork

Assist with employee and contractor documentation

Organise uniforms, office furniture, signage, packaging and supplies

Contact suppliers, request quotes and compare options

Maintain organised Google Drive folders and business records

Assist with pricing updates and administrative changes for existing clients

Handle confidential business and personal information professionally



Executive and occasional personal support



Make calls, send follow-ups and book appointments

Research products, suppliers and services

Assist with event and family administration when required

Take ownership of small projects from beginning to completion

Help reduce my mental load by keeping track of details and following through





The Person I’m Looking For



You will be a great fit if you are:



Proactive and confident taking initiative

Extremely organised and detail-oriented

A quick learner who can understand new businesses and systems

Positive, friendly and willing to help

Reliable and responsive during agreed working hours

Comfortable working independently and making sensible decisions

Able to manage multiple priorities without becoming overwhelmed

Confident following people up and keeping tasks moving

An excellent written and verbal English communicator

Comfortable asking questions when necessary, but able to problem-solve first

Trustworthy with sensitive financial, business and personal information

Looking for a long-term role in which you can grow

Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:



Executive or personal assistance

Digital marketing or a marketing agency

Monday.com or similar project-management platforms

Google Drive, Docs and Sheets

Xero and Ignition

WordPress or Shopify

SEO and Google Business Profile management

Preparing proposals, reports or client documents

Supplier coordination and online research

AI tools, including ChatGPT



You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters most is that you learn quickly, take good notes, retain what you are taught and continuously improve.



What Success Looks Like



The successful person will help me feel in control of my workload. You will know what is outstanding, what is urgent, who needs to be followed up and what can be completed without waiting for me.



Over time, I want you to become someone I can confidently hand a task or problem to and trust that it will be followed through properly.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

An example of a time you took initiative without being asked.

The systems and software you have used.

Your experience with marketing, Xero, Monday.com or executive assistance.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Your availability to work during Sydney business hours.

A short voice recording introducing yourself.

title: ServiceTitan Dispatcher / CSR - HVAC, Plumbing & Electrical (US company, Full-Time)
description:
We are a growing HVAC, Plumbing and Electrical company in Cleveland, Ohio (USA). We run everything on ServiceTitan, and we are looking for ONE excellent full-time Dispatcher / CSR to own our phones and our technicians' schedule.



This is not a "take a message" job. You are the person who turns a phone call into a booked, profitable job.



THE SCHEDULE (please read before applying)

- Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM US EASTERN TIME. 60 hours per week.

- This is a real full-time commitment on US hours. If you cannot work these hours reliably, please do not apply.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Answer inbound calls from American homeowners and BOOK them. We measure booked-call rate, not call count. Leads that die are not leads.

- Build and maintain the daily schedule for our technicians in ServiceTitan: assign, move, cancel and re-book appointments.

- Prioritize smartly. Good, high-value customers get high priority and the best slots; low-margin calls get moved to later slots.

- Stay on top of the technicians: remind them to dispatch, to arrive, and to close out their jobs properly.

- Verify every finished job was actually closed out and that the customer received their invoice.

- Follow up on open estimates and unbooked calls so nothing falls through the cracks.



WHAT WE REQUIRE

- Excellent spoken English with a MINIMAL accent. You will be on the phone with American homeowners all day - this is our #1 requirement.

- Real phone sales ability: you can handle objections and close the appointment.

- ServiceTitan experience is a big plus. Other field-service software plus the ability to learn ServiceTitan fast will also be considered.

- Extremely organized, reliable and proactive. You follow up without being asked.

- Stable internet, a quiet workspace, a good headset, and a working WhatsApp account.



WHAT WE OFFER

- $1,000 - $2,000/month USD to start, based on experience - and it goes up a lot as you take on more responsibility and bring more value to the business.

- Full-time, long-term position with one company. We want to grow with the right person.

- You work directly with the owner. No layers of management.



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these steps will be ignored)

1. Start your message with the word DISPATCH so I know you actually read this ad.

2. Include a link to a 60-second voice recording (Loom, Google Drive, any recorder) where you introduce yourself in English and describe one phone call you personally turned into a booked job.

3. Tell me: your ServiceTitan experience (how long, what you did in it), and confirm you can work Monday to Saturday 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM US Eastern Time.

4. Include your WhatsApp number. Shortlisted candidates will have a live WhatsApp VIDEO interview with the owner.
